title: hbo-stage Bedrijfskunde: Digitalisering en Procesoptimalisatie van communicatie
description: hbo- afstudeerstage, vanaf februari 2027 Ben jij die enthousiaste hbo-student die het leuk vindt om organisatievraagstukken te onderzoeken en processen te verbeteren? Dit is jouw uitdaging Het Centraal Bureau voor de Statistiek (CBS) wil het gebruik van papieren post verminderen en de mogelijkheden voor digitale communicatie verder uitbreiden. Dit geldt zowel voor de communicatie met bedrijven als met personen. Tijdens deze stage richt je je specifiek op de communicatie met individuele onderzoekspersonen. Op dit moment benadert het CBS onderzoekspersonen in eerste instantie vrijwel altijd via een brief op het huisadres. Digitale communicatie, bijvoorbeeld via e-mail, biedt kansen om dit proces efficiënter, flexibeler en toekomstbestendiger in te richten. Er lopen binnen het CBS al verschillende initiatieven om meer gebruik te maken van e-mailadressen, maar er zijn ook nog belangrijke vraagstukken die onderzocht moeten worden. Denk bijvoorbeeld aan de volgende vragen: Hoe kan het CBS op een effectieve manier e-mailadressen van onderzoekspersonen verzamelen en beheren? Welke juridische en privacyvoorwaarden gelden voor het opbouwen en gebruiken van een e-maildatabase? Welke technische aanpassingen en voorzieningen zijn nodig om digitale communicatie mogelijk te maken? Hoe moeten de bestaande werkprocessen worden aangepast om digitale communicatie goed te ondersteunen? Hoe kunnen we ervoor zorgen dat onderzoekspersonen op een toegankelijke en betrouwbare manier digitaal benaderd worden? Samen met het Waarneeminnovatie Team en collega's van de afdeling Dataverzameling ga je dit vraagstuk onderzoeken. Je brengt de huidige situatie in kaart, onderzoekt mogelijkheden voor verbetering en werkt toe naar concrete aanbevelingen voor het CBS. Dit is jouw stageplek bij CBS Heerlen Je gaat aan de slag in het Team Waarneeminnovatie. Dit team valt binnen de afdeling Dataverzameling. We zijn een jong, divers en vooral enthousiast team dat als doel heeft de waarneming van het CBS te vernieuwen en te verbeteren. Dit breng jij mee Je volgt een hbo-opleiding Bedrijfskunde of een soortgelijke opleiding. Je hebt interesse in procesoptimalisatie, digitalisering en organisatieverandering. Je bent nieuwsgierig, onderzoekend en neemt graag initiatief. Je vindt het leuk om met verschillende betrokkenen binnen een organisatie in gesprek te gaan. Je hebt een proactieve, positieve en assertieve houding en denkt in oplossingen, staat open voor feedback en gaat uitdagingen met enthousiasme aan. Omdat tijdens de stage alle communicatie – zowel mondeling als schriftelijk – in het Nederlands plaatsvindt, is een goede beheersing van de Nederlandse taal noodzakelijk. Dit kun je van ons verwachten Een fijne leeromgeving waarin je: samen met ervaren vakmensen bestaande processen analyseert en verbeterkansen herkent; zelfstandig een praktijkgericht onderzoek of experiment opzet; aan de slag gaat met het in kaart brengen van verschillende organisatorische, juridische en technische belangen en randvoorwaarden rondom digitale communicatie; leert om onderzoeksresultaten te vertalen naar concrete, onderbouwde en uitvoerbare aanbevelingen voor het CBS. Voor jouw inzet ontvang je een stagevergoeding van € 800,- bruto per maand (op basis van 40 uur per week). Samen met je stagebegeleider stem je af hoe je hybride kunt werken, met flexibele werktijden en de optie om deels vanuit huis aan jouw stageopdracht te werken. Dit zijn onze voorwaarden Het betreft een stageopdracht en geen werkervaringsplek. Voordat je aan de stage begint verwachten we dat je vanuit de onderwijsinstelling een stagebegeleider hebt, waarmee de stage is afgestemd en concrete leerdoelen zijn afgesproken. title: Senior B2B Growth Marketing Manager (w/m/d)
description: Du willst B2B-Marketing nicht nur „betreuen“, sondern eine Marke sichtbar aufbauen? Bei ABRIO entwickelst du die Marketingfunktion einer spezialisierten Digital-Commerce-Beratung weiter. Du schärfst unsere Positionierung im Shopify- und Enterprise-E-Commerce-Umfeld, entwickelst Content- und LinkedIn-Formate, steuerst Partner- und Event-Marketing und machst aus Sichtbarkeit qualifizierte Nachfrage. Dabei arbeitest du direkt mit der Geschäftsführung und Sales zusammen – mit Budget, Ownership und viel Gestaltungsspielraum. Klingt spannend? Dann lies weiter – wir suchen genau dich für unser Team! DAS ERWARTET DICH Strategische B2B-Positionierung : In enger Zusammenarbeit mit der Geschäftsführung entwickelst du die Marketing Strategy von ABRIO weiter, schärfst unsere B2B-Positionierung inklusive Messaging, USP, ICP und Value Proposition und stärkst unsere Wahrnehmung im Digital-Commerce, Shopify- und Enterprise-E-Commerce-Umfeld. B2B Branding & Brand Management: Du verantwortest unser B2B Branding über Website, LinkedIn Marketing, PR, Content Marketing und Events hinweg und stellst eine hochwertige, konsistente Markenpräsenz über alle relevanten Kanäle sicher. Awareness & Thought Leadership: Über starke Content-Formate, Partner Marketing, Event Marketing und Messeauftritte steigerst du die Sichtbarkeit von ABRIO und etablierst uns als Thought Leader im Premiumsegment für Shopify, E-Commerce und Digital Commerce. KPI-driven Growth: Du definierst KPIs entlang von Brand Awareness, Engagement, Content Performance und Anfragequalität und entwickelst unser Growth Marketing datenbasiert weiter — mit Fokus auf Sichtbarkeit, Relevanz und Markenwachstum. Teamaufbau & Schnittstellenarbeit: Du startest als zentrale Marketingrolle bei ABRIO, arbeitest eng mit Geschäftsführung, Recruiting und Sales zusammen und übernimmst perspektivisch eine wichtige Rolle beim weiteren Ausbau unseres Marketingteams. IT'S A MATCH, SOFERN DU... mindestens 3 Jahre Erfahrung im B2B-Marketing hast und Marken skaliert, weiterentwickelt oder im Brand-Management aktiv gesteuert hast – von der Positionierung bis zur konsistenten Umsetzung über alle relevanten Kanäle. über ein abgeschlossenes Studium im Bereich (Digital) Marketing, Medienmanagement, Betriebswirtschaftslehre oder einer vergleichbaren Fachrichtung verfügst. contentgetriebenes Marketing und LinkedIn-B2B-Branding beherrschst und dich im Sparring mit der Geschäftsführung wohlfühlst. Budgets (mit-)verantwortet hast und Wirkung über KPIs und Tracking messbar machen kannst. Tools wie LinkedIn, CMS (Webflow/WordPress), SEO-Tools und Google Analytics sicher nutzt. mit echter Aufbau-Mentalität dafür brennst, kontinuierlich Neues auszuprobieren, Veränderungen aktiv anzustoßen und ABRIO gezielt als Premium-Partner im DACH-Markt und im Enterprise-Segment zu positionieren. Lust auf hohe Ownership hast, strategisch vorausdenkst und gleichzeitig hands-on sowie zuverlässig mit hohem Qualitätsanspruch operativ umsetzt. sehr gute Deutsch- und gute Englischkenntnisse mitbringst. WAS WIR DIR BIETEN Teamspirit, den man erlebt: Du bringst deine Erfahrung und Perspektive aktiv ein und prägst die Zusammenarbeit in einem offenen, wertschätzenden Team. Regelmäßige Teamevents stärken dabei den gemeinsamen Austausch. Urlaub & Balance: 30 Tage Urlaub und ein kleines Extra für deine Auszeit: ein zusätzlicher Urlaubstag, wenn Heiligabend & Silvester auf Werktage fallen . Arbeitszeiten, die zu dir passen: Wir bieten flexible Arbeitszeiten und 2 - 3 Tage Präsenz im Büro pro Woche. So gestaltest du deinen Arbeitsalltag eigenständig und kannst deine Projekte effizient voranbringen. Weiterbildung, die deine Karriere stärkt: Wir investieren gezielt in deine Entwicklung – mit einem persönlichen Weiterbildungsbudget für Weiterbildungen, Zertifizierungen und Coaching. Leistung wird belohnt: Neben einer Vergütung, die deiner Erfahrung und Verantwortung entspricht, erhältst du attraktive Bonuszahlungen mit klarer Leistungsorientierung und eine Benefitcard mit monatlich 50,00€ netto – flexibel einsetzbar und jeden Monat ein Plus. Spannende Projekte mit echtem Impact: Bei ABRIO gestaltest du anspruchsvolle E-Commerce-Projekte für führende Marken und triffst Entscheidungen, die echte Ergebnisse erzeugen. Gestalte mit und übernimm Verantwortung: Du treibst Themen aktiv voran, bringst deine Erfahrung ein und setzt deine mehrjährige Expertise gezielt ein, um echte Ergebnisse zu erzielen und unser Team voranzutreiben. Unsere Werte – gelebter Alltag: Teamgeist, Professionalität und Leidenschaft prägen unser tägliches Handeln. Bei uns bekommst du den Raum, Verantwortung zu übernehmen und Entscheidungen zu treffen, die spürbare Qualität und Wirkung entfalten. Modernes Büro im Herzen Frankfurts: Eine hochwertige Arbeitsumgebung mit moderner Ausstattung für fokussiertes Arbeiten, kreativen Austausch und produktive Zusammenarbeit. Mit uns erhältst du nicht nur einen Job, sondern eine Erfahrung, die dich weiterbringt – beruflich und persönlich! 🚀 Unser Team steht für flache Hierarchien und Eigeninitiative. Wenn du motiviert bist, Verantwortung übernehmen möchtest und Lust hast, gemeinsam mit uns die Zukunft des E-Commerce zu gestalten, dann bist du bei uns genau richtig! Unser Bewerbungsprozess ist schnell und zuverlässig – wir melden uns innerhalb kürzester Zeit bei dir zurück. Also, bewirb dich noch heute und werde Teil unseres dynamischen Teams. After six months, you know the code well and have shipped several new features. Qualifikationen Umfangreiche Erfahrung in der Vertriebskanalentwicklung, in den Sales Operations oder in der kennzahlengesteuerten Marktsteuerung in einem Customer Care- oder Cloud/SaaS-Umfeld. Nachweisbares Verständnis oder praktische Erfahrung in der Monetarisierung automatisierter Interaktionskanäle (Voicebots, Chatbots, Mail-KI). description: Du verstehst Prozesse schneller als andere und willst Kunden mit einer Lösung überzeugen, die wirklich passt? Dann verbinde bei uns Beratung, Technik und Vertrieb in einer Rolle. Wer wir sind docu-fix digitalisiert den sozialwirtschaftlichen Mittelstand. Wir automatisieren Prozesse rund um Dokumente: Scan-Dienstleistungen, Dokumentenmanagement (u. a. DocuWare), Workflows und E-Signatur. Unsere Kunden sind unter anderem Träger der Sozialwirtschaft, Rechenzentren und öffentliche Verkehrsbetriebe. Damit aus diesen Terminen Projekte werden, suchen wir dich. Was du machst Du übernimmst die Termine, die unser Inside Sales vereinbart, und führst sie bis zum Abschluss. Du nimmst Prozesse auf. Im Erstgespräch und im Workshop fragst du so lange nach, bis klar ist, wo beim Kunden Zeit und Geld liegen bleiben. Du zeigst die Lösung. In der Demo sieht der Kunde seinen eigenen Rechnungseingang, seine Personalakte oder seinen Vertragsprozess – nicht eine Standardpräsentation. Du entwirfst das Lösungskonzept: welche Bausteine aus Scan, DocuWare, Workflow, Schnittstellen und E-Signatur zusammenpassen und was sie bringen. Du kalkulierst den Aufwand, schreibst das Angebot gemeinsam mit dem Vertrieb und vertrittst es vor Geschäftsführung, IT-Leitung und Fachabteilung. Du übergibst gewonnene Projekte sauber dokumentiert an unser Team Technischer Service & Implementierung und bleibst für den Kunden ansprechbar. Du baust Wiederverwendbares auf: Demo-Umgebungen, Lösungsvorlagen und Referenzszenarien für unsere Zielbranchen. Worauf du dich einstellst Wir verkaufen kein Standardprodukt. Jeder Kunde hat andere Systeme, andere Abläufe und andere Vorgaben – du baust daraus eine Lösung, die trägt. Du sprichst mit Geschäftsführung, IT-Leitung und Buchhaltung. Die eine will Zahlen, die andere Architektur, die dritte einen Alltag, der funktioniert. Du stehst zwischen Vertrieb und Technik. Du versprichst nur, was unser Implementierungsteam liefern kann. Du arbeitest an mehreren Kunden gleichzeitig und hältst Fristen für Angebote und Ausschreibungen. Du bist bei Kunden vor Ort und online unterwegs. Wen wir suchen Du hast Erfahrung in Presales, Consulting, Business Analyse oder der Einführung von Unternehmenssoftware. Du denkst in Prozessen. Du verstehst, wie ein Rechnungseingang, eine Freigabe oder eine Aktenführung abläuft, und siehst, wo es hakt. Du erklärst Technik so, dass eine Geschäftsführung entscheidet und eine IT-Leitung zustimmt. Du bist technisch fit: Schnittstellen, Cloud und On-Premises, Berechtigungen und Datenmodelle sind dir vertraut. Programmieren musst du nicht. Du schreibst Konzepte und Angebote, die man ohne Rückfrage versteht. Du arbeitest selbstständig, verbindlich und gern im Team mit Vertrieb und Technik. Du sprichst verhandlungssicher Deutsch, weil Workshops, Konzepte und Angebote auf Deutsch laufen. Hilft, ist aber kein Muss Erfahrung mit DocuWare oder anderen DMS-, ECM- oder Workflow-Systemen Kenntnis der Sozialwirtschaft, des öffentlichen Sektors oder von ERP- und Finanzbuchhaltungssystemen Erfahrung mit E-Rechnung, E-Signatur oder revisionssicherer Archivierung Was dir fehlt, bringen wir dir bei. NaroIQ gives ManCos a fast, reliable path into the ETF market. We provide the digital ETF infrastructure that reduces operational complexity, so ManCos can launch and run ETFs at scale and compete effectively, helping broaden access to the market beyond dominant, US-based providers.

The Role and What Makes It Special

You own the two functions that decide how the outside world experiences NaroIQ: How we are perceived in the market, and who we manage to attract to build it. Marketing and Employer Branding sit together in one role at NaroIQ because the same narrative - sharp, technical, high quality - has to land with senior executives and journalists as well as with the engineers, operators and commercial talent we want to hire next.

That takes unusual self-drive - the kind where nobody has to ask you for a status update, and where an unclear brief is something you resolve rather than escalate.

You report to the CEO (Chris) and work in tight loops with Growth, Product and the leadership team. Over time, you have the opportunity to grow the function around you.

Tasks

What You'll Do

PR & Events

  • Run PR campaigns end-to-end, directly and with external PR partners, to build durable credibility and secure consistent placements in tier-1 outlets (Handelsblatt, Bloomberg, FT) and the FinTech and asset-management publications that matter
  • Build and maintain a working network of journalists and editors; develop narratives that sharpen NaroIQ's positioning
  • Plan and coordinate events and speaking slots (e.g. Money20/20, FinTech and asset-management conferences, exclusive industry roundtables)

Content & Brand

  • Build a scalable content and thought-leadership engine that actively supports sales enablement and pipeline progression
  • Grow NaroIQ's organic LinkedIn presence at the company and founder level. A steady cadence of substantive posts, not noise.
  • Build and maintain a consistent brand identity across every surface: website, pitch deck, one-pagers, careers page, sales collateral
  • Create a brand that sticks with our audience: You decide how we are perceived in the market and what the NaroIQ storyline should look like

Demand Generation & Sales Alignment

  • Develop the materials that prepare and accelerate enterprise conversations: one-pagers, decks, whitepapers, case studies
  • Build and run inbound growth motions: SEO, AI search optimization, and targeted growth experiments
  • Close the loop with Sales: instrument what's working, kill what isn't, feed campaign learnings back into product and positioning

Employer Branding

  • Build NaroIQ's employer brand into a real asset: a careers narrative that pulls senior talent in, a candidate experience that earns referrals

  • You treat candidates as an audience: you can write a role description that makes people apply, shape how NaroIQ shows up to talent, and equip hiring managers with a story worth telling
  • A taste-led approach to brand: you can hold a consistent visual and verbal system across surfaces and push back on output that breaks it
  • Structured and genuinely self-directed: you're comfortable operating with ambiguity, high ownership and no cover in a small, fast-moving team
  • Fluent in English and German, written and spoken

We trust you to take full responsibility for your work. That means freedom and also being the person others rely on when things get real.

🛠 Default to Rethink

Für diese Aufgabe suchen wir bei Fluitronics einen erfahrenen Nachfolger in unserer Projektierung. Entscheidend ist Ihr Verständnis für das Zusammenspiel von Hydraulik, Antrieb und Motorentechnik. Der Schwerpunkt liegt dabei auf der technischen Systemauslegung des Hydrauliksystems mit den nötigen spezifischen Details. Das bieten wir Ihnen Eine attraktive Vergütung, bei der Ihre Erfahrung und Ihr Know-how zählen Hybrides Arbeiten mit flexiblen Arbeitszeiten (Gleitzeit, Abstimmung im Team) Moderne Entwicklungsumgebung und direkte Nähe zu Versuch & Prototypen Spannende und vielseitige Projekte, viel Gestaltungsspielraum und kurze Entscheidungswege Perspektive für fachliche Entwicklung und neue Verantwortungsbereiche 30 Tage Urlaub Betriebliche Altersvorsorge Regelmäßige Firmenevents Ihre Aufgaben Anforderungen verstehen: Sie klären mit Kunden und Vertrieb, welche Funktionen benötigt werden und welche technischen, wirtschaftlichen und terminlichen Rahmenbedingungen gelten. Produkte weiterbetreuen: Sie bearbeiten technische Änderungen und entwickeln bestehende Lösungen weiter. Fragen klären: Sie stimmen sich mit Kunden, Lieferanten, Konstruktion und Produktion ab und unterstützen bei technischen Anfragen. Ihr Profil Abgeschlossenes Studium im Maschinenbau oder einer vergleichbaren technischen Fachrichtung; alternativ Weiterbildung zum staatlich geprüften Techniker mit einschlägiger Berufserfahrung Mehrjährige Berufserfahrung in der Projektierung oder Auslegung hydraulischer Systeme, idealerweise etwa sechs bis zehn Jahre Fundierte Fachkenntnisse in Hydraulik, Mobilhydraulik sowie Antriebs- und Motorentechnik Sehr gutes technisches Verständnis und die Fähigkeit, komplexe Systemzusammenhänge zu beurteilen Erfahrung im Umgang mit technischen Unterlagen, Stücklisten und ERP-Systemen Selbstständige und strukturierte Arbeitsweise sowie eine klare, verbindliche Kommunikation Verhandlungssichere Deutschkenntnisse und sehr gute Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift Nice-to-have Kenntnisse in der Regelungstechnik oder Erfahrung mit CAN-Bus-Kommunikation ergänzen Ihr Profil. Als Teil der internationalen Eddie Group mit rund 3.800 Mitarbeitenden weltweit arbeiten wir mit Teams und Partnern über Ländergrenzen hinweg zusammen – bei kurzen Wegen und globalen Fertigungsmöglichkeiten. Warum diese Position? Kaum ein Projekt ist wie das andere: Unterschiedliche Branchen, Anwendungen und Technologien bringen neue Herausforderungen. Ihre Lösungen begleiten Sie bis zur Serie. Im Zuge des Generationswechsels in unserer Projektierung übernehmen Sie eine wichtige Fachfunktion – mit Freiraum für eigene Lösungen und der Möglichkeit, Ihre Rolle und Verantwortung weiterzuentwickeln. title: Senior Privacy Counsel (m/f/d)
description: Deep Blue Recruitment is working with an international technology company looking to appoint an experienced Senior Privacy Counsel to join its legal team. Operating in the enterprise technology sector, the business develops software and digital solutions for customers across a range of industries. With continued investment in emerging technologies, including AI, data protection is becoming an increasingly important consideration in how the business develops its products, manages risk and works with customers. We're looking for a commercially minded privacy lawyer who enjoys working closely with the business, understanding how technology works and finding practical solutions to complex legal questions. This is a broad, hands-on role combining privacy advisory work, commercial support and the continued development of internal data protection processes. What You'll Be Doing Advise colleagues across the business on a broad range of privacy and data protection matters, providing clear, commercially focused legal guidance. Work closely with product, technology and commercial teams on the development of new services, ensuring privacy considerations are addressed early in the process. Support the negotiation of commercial agreements, particularly around data processing, international transfers, customer relationships and third-party arrangements. Advise on GDPR and other applicable international data protection regulations, helping the business understand and manage its obligations across different markets. Provide legal guidance on emerging technologies, including AI, and the implications of new products and data processing activities from a privacy perspective. Review and improve existing privacy policies, internal procedures and governance frameworks to ensure they remain practical and fit for purpose. Work alongside information security and IT teams on data governance, risk assessments and privacy-related incidents. Identify opportunities to improve the efficiency of privacy operations, including through automation and better internal processes. Monitor regulatory developments affecting technology businesses, particularly around data protection, AI and digital services. Provide training and guidance to colleagues across the organisation, helping non-legal teams understand their responsibilities when handling personal data. What They're Looking For A qualified lawyer with approximately 4-10 years experience specialising in data protection, privacy or technology law, gained in private practice, in-house or a combination of both. Strong knowledge of GDPR and European data protection law, including regulatory guidance and its practical application within commercial organisations. Experience advising technology businesses, ideally with exposure to software, AI, digital products or other data-intensive environments. A good understanding of artificial intelligence technologies and the legal and regulatory challenges associated with their development and use. Experience advising on commercial agreements involving personal data, international transfers and complex data processing arrangements. Comfortable working directly with product, engineering and technical stakeholders, with the ability to understand complex issues and provide clear, practical legal advice. A commercial approach to risk management, recognising that the role of legal is to help the business find workable solutions rather than simply identify problems. Strong organisational skills and the ability to manage multiple projects and competing priorities independently. Experience working within an international business or advising on privacy matters across multiple jurisdictions would be beneficial. Why Consider This Opportunity? This is an opportunity to join an international technology business where privacy plays an important role in how the company operates, develops its products and works with customers. You'll have a broad remit, working closely with different teams across the organisation on a range of commercial, operational and regulatory matters, including some of the challenges emerging technologies bring to data protection. If you're a privacy lawyer who enjoys working closely with the business, has an interest in technology and takes a practical approach to solving legal challenges, we'd be interested in hearing from you. title: Werkstudent (m/w/d) - AI Enablement & Adoption
description: Über XCNT XCNT baut Software mit einem digitalen Herzen und einer industriellen Seele als digitaler Produktbuilder der PARIGROUP SE. Die Ideen entstehen innerhalb dieser europäischen Herstellergruppe und werden so gestaltet, dass sie darüber hinaus skalieren. Wir bei XCNT arbeiten daran, künstliche Intelligenz im Unternehmensalltag nutzbar zu machen. Gemeinsam mit den Unternehmen unserer Gruppe identifizieren wir passende Anwendungsfälle, entwickeln unsere KI-Angebote weiter und unterstützen Mitarbeitende dabei, sie sinnvoll einzusetzen. Dabei geht es nicht darum, möglichst viele Tools vorzustellen. Wir wollen konkrete Probleme lösen und KI dort in Arbeitsabläufe integrieren, wo sie wirklich hilft. Dafür suchen wir dich: Du hast Freude an Technologie, gehst offen auf Menschen zu und möchtest gemeinsam mit ihnen herausfinden, wie KI ihre tägliche Arbeit verbessern kann. Deine Aufgaben im Bereich AI Enablement & Adoption Du machst aus ersten KI-Experimenten eine hilfreiche Routine. Ob im persönlichen Austausch, in abteilungsspezifischen Workshops oder gemeinsam mit unseren AI Champions: Du hilfst Mitarbeitenden, passende Anwendungen zu finden, Hürden zu überwinden und KI selbstständig einzusetzen. Gleichzeitig bringst du ihre Erfahrungen und Anforderungen in die Weiterentwicklung unserer internen KI-Plattform auf Basis von OpenWebUI ein. AI Enablement & Adoption – rund 70 % Im Alltag unterstützen: Du bist Ansprechperson für Fragen zur KI-Nutzung. Du hilfst bei konkreten Problemen und bindest bei Bedarf die richtigen Fachleute ein. Abteilungsspezifische Workshops gestalten: Du bereitest Workshops auf Deutsch und Englisch vor und führst sie durch – mit echten Aufgaben der jeweiligen Teams statt allgemeiner Tool-Demos. AI Champions unterstützen: Du begleitest engagierte Mitarbeitende, die KI in ihren Bereichen voranbringen, und unterstützt ihren Austausch untereinander. Anwendungsfälle gemeinsam entwickeln: Du findest mit den Teams heraus, wo KI sinnvoll unterstützen kann, erprobst passende Ansätze und begleitest die ersten Schritte im Alltag. Wissen zugänglich machen: Du bereitest hilfreiche Beispiele, Anleitungen und Best Practices so auf, dass andere sie direkt nutzen können. Dranbleiben: Du fragst nach, ob Lösungen tatsächlich helfen, und erkennst, wo weitere Unterstützung nötig ist. Dazu gehört auch der gelegentliche Austausch vor Ort in den Unternehmen unserer Gruppe. Die Stelle ist also mit Reisen verbunden (DE/Europa). Nutzerbedürfnisse & Produktanforderungen – rund 30 % Bedarf verstehen: Du sammelst Feedback aus Workshops, Support-Anfragen und Gesprächen mit unseren AI Champions. Anforderungen für OpenWebUI formulieren: Du beschreibst nachvollziehbar, welches Problem gelöst werden soll, für wen es relevant ist und was eine hilfreiche Lösung leisten muss. Muster erkennen: Du unterscheidest zwischen einzelnen Rückfragen, Schulungsbedarf und wiederkehrenden Produktanforderungen. Verbesserungen begleiten: Du stimmst Anforderungen mit dem technischen Team ab, testest neue Funktionen aus Nutzersicht und erklärst sie den Mitarbeitenden. Du musst dafür keine vollständigen Softwarelösungen allein entwickeln. Wichtig ist, dass du technische Zusammenhänge verstehst und zwischen Anwendern und Entwicklung vermitteln kannst. Dein Profil Du bist eingeschrieben, idealerweise am Anfang deines Masterstudiums – beispielsweise in Wirtschaftsinformatik, Informatik, Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen oder einem vergleichbaren Studiengang im ersten oder zweiten Semester. Du nutzt generative KI bereits praktisch und kannst erklären, wo sie hilfreich ist und wo ihre Grenzen liegen. Du gehst gerne auf Menschen zu, hörst aufmerksam zu und fragst nach, bevor du eine Lösung vorschlägst. Du kannst technische Themen verständlich vermitteln und hast Freude daran, andere beim Lernen zu unterstützen. Du arbeitest strukturiert und eigenständig und behältst offene Fragen im Blick. Du bringst ein grundlegendes Verständnis für Software und webbasierte Anwendungen mit. Du kommunizierst sehr gut auf Deutsch und Englisch. Ein Plus, kein Muss: Erste Erfahrungen mit OpenWebUI, Workshops, Anwendersupport, Anforderungsmanagement oder Automatisierung. Deine ersten Monate Woran du merkst, dass du einen guten Job machst Mitarbeitende kommen bei ihren konkreten Aufgaben weiter – durch deine Unterstützung oder weil du sie an die richtige Stelle vermittelt hast. Teams nutzen KI nach einem Workshop eigenständig und sinnvoll weiter. Unsere AI Champions können ihre Kolleginnen und Kollegen besser unterstützen. Wiederkehrende Hürden werden sichtbar und fließen als klare Anforderungen in die Weiterentwicklung unserer KI-Plattform ein. Kurz: Nicht die Zahl deiner Workshops zählt, sondern ob deine Arbeit den Alltag der Menschen verbessert. Was die Rolle besonders macht Du verbindest Technologie, Zusammenarbeit und praktische Problemlösung. Du gestaltest mit, wie KI in unterschiedlichen Unternehmen und Fachbereichen eingesetzt wird. Du bekommst direktes Feedback und siehst, was deine Arbeit bewirkt. Du kannst eigene Ideen einbringen und Schritt für Schritt Verantwortung übernehmen. description: HYROX is a global sports event series that combines running and functional fitness training in a unique race format. Founded in Germany in 2017, HYROX has evolved into a worldwide fitness movement with events across five continents, attracting millions of athletes every season. We are building the premier global fitness racing brand, empowering people of all backgrounds to train and compete together. As HYROX Nutrition Activation Manager (m/f/d), you will be the driving force behind bringing our sports nutrition category to life directly on the global race floor! You will lead the charge in planning and executing high-energy event activations, immersive sampling setups, and live consumer touchpoints that fuel our athletes and captivate thousands of spectators worldwide. If you thrive in fast-paced event environments, love building unforgettable brand experiences, and want to own our global field activation strategy, this is your arena! YOUR KEY RESPONSIBILITIES Event Activation & On-Site Execution: Plan, direct, and execute all HYROX Nutrition category activations, store setups, and sampling stations across key regional markets, prioritizing European events as the foundation for broader international expansion. Manage end-to-end event logistics for the nutrition brand, including inventory, booth infrastructure, branding assets, and supplier coordination. Lead on-site staff during event weekends to ensure high-energy execution, perfect brand presence, and excellent customer engagement. Sampling & Engagement Strategy: Develop and optimize targeted sampling strategies to maximize product trial, consumer education, and conversion among athletes and spectators. Create interactive, high-impact activation concepts that drive product sales, social media buzz, and direct-to-consumer (D2C) lead generation during events. Coordinate on-site influencer and ambassador activations in close alignment with the HYROX Nutrition Marketing Manager and wider marketing team. Stakeholder & Partner Coordination: Serve as the main point of contact on-site for external brand partners and sponsors participating in HYROX Nutrition event activations. Work in close cross-functional collaboration with internal departments (Direct Sales, Operations, Partnerships) to ensure smooth event delivery. Coordinate with venue teams and local suppliers to meet safety, layout, and operational requirements. Budget & Process Management : Manage, track, and optimize the allocated activation budget for all event-related nutrition initiatives. Streamline event preparation workflows, tools, and timelines using project management platforms (e.g., Monday.com). Evaluate post-event performance through KPI tracking (sampling volume, sales conversion, lead capture) to continuously refine future event setups. YOUR PROFILE Experience: 3+ years of hands-on experience in event marketing, experiential marketing, or field activation, ideally within Sports Nutrition, FMCG, Fitness, or Lifestyle brands. Event & Onsite Expertise: Strong track record in planning and executing large-scale live event activations, pop-ups, or trade show setups from concept to tear-down. Hands-On Leadership: Energetic personality with proven experience leading on-site teams, brand ambassadors, and event personnel in high-tempo event environments. Logistics & Organization: Process-driven with strong operational skills; experienced in managing project workflows (e.g., Monday.com) and managing event budgets. Flexibility & Travel: High flexibility and readiness to travel frequently for weekend event execution across key markets. Languages: Business-fluent English skills (written and spoken) are required; German or additional languages are a plus. WHAT WE OFFER The opportunity to take on responsibility in a fast-growing, international company with a strong sports DNA. Flat hierarchies, quick decision-making processes, and plenty of room for your ideas. A motivated, international team with a genuine passion for sports and events. A healthy work-life balance thanks to flexible, trust-based working hours. A modern office in a top location – right in Hamburg Altona with excellent transport connections. 28 vacation days to recharge and reset. A Wellpass membership and discounted lunch options in-house. Your Deutschlandticket is fully covered by us – nationwide mobility, 100% on us. Employee discounts in our HYROX stores. INTERESTED? Then we look forward to receiving your application. As a part of the larger Engineering department, the Platform team plays a crucial role in enhancing emnify competitive edge by improving developer experience to increase development efficiency and scale productivity.

Emnify technology radar

  • You’ll design, implement, and maintain K8s-based solutions, clusters, and supporting AWS infrastructure that help other engineering teams run their applications reliably on Kubernetes. You’ll elevate how we deliver our business-critical applications on Kubernetes

  • You’ll work closely with the security team to maintain and increase emnify's security posture.

description:

As a global agency, we provide a full suite of services across healthcare communications and marketing to our clients, including top players in the pharmaceutical and biotech industries.

Our #LifeatRealChem culture is rooted in our people—we believe we are best together and are committed to excellence for both our clients and colleagues. Whether you're a seasoned professional or just starting your career, if you share our passion for healthcare and connection, we invite you to explore our opportunities.

Discover your purpose. Embrace innovation. Experience #LifeatRealChem.

Job Summary:

Real Chemistry is looking for an Associate Account Director to join our growing team! 

As an Associate Account Director, you will be responsible for excellence in delivery across projects within medium-to-large and often complex client accounts. You will provide strategic counsel to clients, manage execution of parallel ongoing projects and oversee a cross-functional internal team alongside the account lead.

This role will be supporting on some of our promotional medical education accounts and include projects such as events and patient-based campaigns.

 

Responsibilities:

  • Act as the go-to for clients, managing relationships and setting their expectations
  • Take accountability for a portfolio of projects within at least two medium-to-large client accounts
  • Ensure work is delivered to the highest standard and within agreed timeframes and budgets
  • Troubleshoot and provide solutions to client challenges and last-minute requests
  • Identify areas for organic growth within existing accounts and confidently sell new ideas to clients
  • Identify new business opportunities outside of existing accounts and explore with the support of senior leadership
  • Support the ongoing new business process, assisting in the production of credentials and participating in broader RFP responses when possible
  • Inspire, motivate, and empower your team on a daily basis, leading by example and setting the standard for junior accounts team members
  • Provide line management, coaching and mentoring to junior team members and manage their performance
  • Take responsibility for financial management of your client business and participate actively in the monthly financial process (including developing budgets)
  • Accurately forecast and proactively alert senior leadership to any changes/potential slowing down of business

 

This position is a perfect fit for you if:

  • Our Company values – Best Together, Impact-Obsessed, Excellence Expected, Evolve Always and Accountability with an “I” – really speak to you.
  • You are adaptable, resilient, and OK with adjusting your scope, responsibilities, and focus as we grow. When things change, so do we. We’re always evolving.
  • You are proactive, driven, and resourceful with strong prioritization skills and a desire to dive into the data.
  • You are highly organized self-starter, able to work independently and under tight deadlines.

 

Skills & Experience:

  • Experience as an Associate Account Director, or Senior Account Manager looking to step up
  • Experience in a medical communications agency
  • Experience working on promotional medical education or commercial medical affairs accounts
  • Ability to work within and lead cross-functional teams internally 
  • Experience with annual planning, resourcing, and forecasting

title: Senior Product Manager, Agentic Search
description:
The role 

We are looking for a Senior Product Manager to join our Agentic Search team, building the search and retrieval infrastructure that powers AI agents and LLM-based applications at scale.

This is a hands-on IC role with real ownership. You will take full end-to-end responsibility over a core product area, from defining strategy through shipping and iterating based on real usage data. You will work within a small PM team reporting to the Director of Product, alongside engineering, design, and go-to-market, shaping how AI agents discover, retrieve, and act on web information in real time.

The product serves both a developer-facing PLG motion and a growing enterprise customer base, so you will need to be equally comfortable digging into API design and search quality as you are running customer discovery calls and informing competitive positioning. We are looking for someone who can operate as a senior strategic partner, not just an executor, and who has the potential to grow into a principal-level PM over time.

You’re welcome to work hybrid from Tel Aviv, Israel.

Your responsibilities will include: 

  • Own a core product area end-to-end: strategy, roadmap, execution, and iteration based on real usage signals and customer feedback.
  • Drive search quality and relevance improvements by working closely with engineering and research to define evaluation frameworks, benchmarks, and release criteria.
  • Engage directly with enterprise customers and developer users to validate ideas, understand pain points, and shape product-market fit across both PLG and enterprise motions.
  • Monitor the competitive landscape in agentic search and AI-powered retrieval, identifying shifts, threats, and opportunities that should inform product decisions.
  • Collaborate with go-to-market teams (sales, solutions, growth) to ensure product positioning, ICP definitions, and enablement materials reflect product reality.
  • Contribute to product strategy as a senior voice on a small, high-impact team, challenging assumptions and bringing independent judgment to key decisions.
  • Lead product experiments and rapid iteration cycles, moving from hypothesis to prototype to production with clear success criteria.

The Project Management team takes hx customers from signed contract to live in production.   • Lead delivery across the projects in our Strategic pod, holding commercials to plan and surfacing risks early.

  • Run several projects at once with commercial accountability.

Benefits

  • £5,000 training and conference budget for individual and group development.

  • 25 days of holiday plus 8 bank holidays (33 days total).

  • Income protection and Life Insurance.

These are the decisions that shape real-world outcomes: whether rockets successfully launch into space, autonomous vehicles make it to market, or communities recover after major storms.

Until now, insurers have been making billion-dollar decisions using outdated tools. We’re changing that. Our platform brings together data, AI, and human expertise to give insurers the fastest path from submission to decision - helping them move faster, act smarter, and take on more risk with confidence.

Backed by a16z, Highland Europe, and Battery Ventures, we’re scaling globally - already trusted by nearly 50 of the world’s largest insurers, with close to zero churn and billions in premiums flowing through hx.

What began as a single product in one market has rapidly evolved into a multi-product, multi-territory platform powering every stage of pricing and underwriting. AI is at the core of what we do - from building the world’s first domain-specific AI peer programmer for insurance (think GitHub Copilot with a PhD in actuarial science) to shaping agentic workflows that reinvent how this industry operates.

What makes hx different is the people who build it. Here, impact isn’t tied to title or tenure; it’s defined by the challenges you take on and the discipline you bring. Surrounded by peers who stretch you, you’ll do the best, hardest work of your life in a company engineered to endure.

If that sounds like you, join us in building what comes next.

About the Project Management team

The Project Management team takes hx customers from signed contract to live in production. We work in cross-functional pods alongside delivery engineers and solution architects, and we own the customer relationship day to day: the plan, the budget, the risks and the conversations that go with them. We work with some of the most sophisticated insurers in the world, including Lloyd’s syndicates, Tier 1 carriers, reinsurers and MGAs. We are moving to a shared, AI-first way of working, where one set of skills is used and improved by the whole team, and we are looking for people who want to help build it.

What you’ll be doing

  • Run a customer project from kick-off to go-live, keeping budget, timeline and project hygiene on track.

  • Be the day-to-day contact for your customer, and tell them early when something is slipping.

  • Work with delivery engineers and solution architects in your pod to turn what the customer needs into a plan the team can deliver.

  • Use our shared delivery skills and AI tools to cut manual project admin, and flag where they fall short.

  • Learn from your delivery lead and bring proposed answers, not just questions.

  • Help us improve how we run projects as you learn what works.

What you’ll need to have done

  • Delivered something to a deadline with other people depending on you (work, university or a side project), and be able to say exactly what you did.

  • Used AI in your work or studies day to day, and be able to explain what it produced and how you checked it.

  • Taken feedback and changed how you work, with an example.

  • Gone beyond the surface of a problem to find out what was really going on.

You’re unlikely to thrive here if

  • You’d prefer a long runway of shadowing before taking on real responsibility. You’ll own a customer project early, with coaching alongside you.

  • You’re uncomfortable being the person customers turn to when something goes wrong or when there is hard news to deliver.

  • You wait for direction rather than forming a view and bringing it to the team.

If reading our Culture Document leaves you feeling neutral rather than energised, hx may not be the place where you’ll do your best work. We’re building something that asks for commitment and conviction, and we want you to feel excited by the opportunity to grow with us.

Compensation

At hx, we’re committed to salary transparency. You’ll always have clarity on pay early in the process - our Talent Partner will share details with you during initial conversations - and we’re working towards publishing salary information for all roles globally.

Because we’re building at the intersection of technology/SaaS and insurance, our roles don’t always map neatly onto traditional benchmarks. Our approach is to design compensation that’s competitive in the market, fair across teams, and aligned with the impact our people make.

Benefits

  • £5,000 training and conference budget for individual and group development.

  • 25 days of holiday plus 8 bank holidays (33 days total).

  • Company pension scheme via Penfold.

  • Mental health support and therapy via Spectrum.life.

  • Individual wellbeing allowance via Juno.

  • Private healthcare insurance through AXA.

  • Income protection and Life Insurance.

  • Cycle to Work Scheme

Additional perks

  • Top-spec equipment (laptop, screens, adjustable desks, etc.).

  • Regular remote and in-person hackathons, lunch and learns, socials, and game nights.

  • Team breakfasts and lunches, snacks, drinks fridge, and a fun office at The Ministry.

  • Exceptional opportunities for personal development and growth as we build something remarkable together.

Interview process

  • Initial call with our Talent team - 30 minutes

  • Manager Interview - 60 minutes

  • Skills presentation - 60 minutes

  • Values Interview - 60 minutes

  • Meet the CEO - 30 minutes

Our commitment to Diversity

hxer’s are at the centre of everything we build. We know that progress depends on diverse perspectives, and we are committed to creating an environment where everyone can thrive, grow, and make an impact. We recognise there is always more to do, and we take responsibility for shaping a workplace that is not only diverse but genuinely inclusive.

Diversity is not just the right thing to do, it is key to solving the complex challenges we choose to take on. By welcoming people from all backgrounds and experiences, we strengthen our ability to question assumptions, push boundaries, and design solutions that endure. If you’re energised by complexity and motivated to grow, we encourage you to apply and join our global team.

Next steps

If this opportunity resonates with you, we encourage you to apply or share it with your connections! Our dedicated talent team reviews all applications, and we promise to provide feedback regardless of the outcome.

For more information about applying and to view other opportunities, you can visit our careers page.

Please note that background checks will be conducted as part of the hiring process to ensure compliance with our governance policies. We handle all background checks sensitively and in full compliance with relevant regulations. All applicant data will be processed in accordance with data protection regulations and our privacy policy.

Dust is backed by Sequoia with a determined team of optimists (coming from Stripe, OpenAI, and Stanford) who like to focus on users, ship fast, and don't take themselves too seriously while doing so. The Generalist named us among the Future 50 . As field marketing specialist, France, you will be the execution owner for Dust’s local Marketing activities. Working closely with the France Marketing Lead, you will turn defined priorities into high-quality events, localized webinars, social media, content and partner marketing activations that support Sales, BDRs and pipeline generation. The France Marketing Lead owns the strategy, budget, programme selection and priorities. You will own execution, coordination, content delivery and continuous improvement across the French Marketing motion. You will be part of a growing Marketing team across the US, UK and France, managed by the Global Head of Marketing. Key Responsibilities Own the execution of the French event and webinar programme Execute conferences, Dust-owned events and localized webinars selected and scoped by the France Marketing Lead. Coordinate the preparation, stakeholders, content, landing pages and logistics needed for a smooth delivery. Work closely with Sales and BDRs to prepare target accounts, follow-up plans and event-related content. Collect feedback, measure performance and document learnings after each activity. Support AEs with relevant content and messaging for their LinkedIn activity. Coordinate with Global Marketing, Product, Customer Success, Design and external media partners to deliver relevant content for French enterprise audiences. Turn events, customer conversations and market insights into reusable content, including customer stories, blog posts, videos, YouTube content and Sales assets. Support partner marketing and Growth programmes Provide execution and logistical support for regional partner marketing activities within the strategy, selection and budget defined by the France Marketing Lead. Support Growth with French-market content for ABM, webinars and paid campaigns. Produce or reformat assets such as e-books, landing pages, customer content and campaign materials. Connect event, content and partner marketing activities to target account engagement and pipeline generation. Coordinate cross-functional Marketing initiatives Identify opportunities to automate repetitive Marketing tasks , Build Dust agents and workflows to support research, event preparation, content repurposing, Sales enablement, reporting and follow-up. Requirements 3+ years of experience in B2B Marketing , ideally across Field Marketing, Event Marketing, Content Marketing or Product Marketing, preferably in SaaS or technology. End-to-end event ownership with the ability to plan and deliver conferences, executive events and Dust-owned events, from preparation through execution and post-event follow-up. Strong content and social media skills with experience creating or repurposing content for enterprise audiences across social media, landing pages, customer stories, YouTube, Sales enablement and executive LinkedIn profiles. Commercial and pipeline mindset with a clear understanding of how events, content and account-based activities support Sales, BDRs, direct pipeline and partner-led growth. Excellent communication skills in French and English , both written and spoken. You can write clearly and accurately, adapt your tone to different audiences and communicate credibly with enterprise executives. Generalist and hands-on approach . You are comfortable moving between event ownership, content creation, Sales preparation, webinars, campaign assets and operational coordination. Strong organisational skills and attention to detail . You anticipate needs, manage deadlines reliably and ensure that projects, events and content are properly prepared before launch. Self-starter mentality . You take initiative, make decisions, solve problems and own outcomes rather than waiting to be told what to do. Strong cross-functional collaboration skills . You know how to find and coordinate the right people across Marketing, Sales, BDRs, Customer Success, Partnerships and external partners. Nice to have: Experience marketing to French enterprise or CAC 40 audiences, working with agencies or media partners, supporting paid campaigns, producing webinars or video content, and working with tools such as HubSpot, Google Workspace and Figma. Location and travel: Based in Paris, comfortable working on-site and willing to travel occasionally for events in France. What Makes This Role Unique Direct pipeline impact: Your work will directly support Sales and BDRs through events, content and ABM activations. Execution ownership in France: You will turn the priorities defined by the France Marketing Lead into high-quality events, content, social media and partner marketing activations in France. AI-native Marketing: You will use Dust to automate research, preparation, content production, reporting and follow-up. Generalist scope: The role combines events, content, social media, webinars, Sales enablement and ABM. Market-shaping opportunity: Help establish Dust as a leading voice in the French enterprise and agentic AI market. Location We're prioritizing building our team with an in-person culture at our offices in Paris, London, San Francisco, and New York because we value the magic that happens when talented people work closely together. We have an office-first culture. Some of the best things about building at Dust are the energy, the fast decisions, and the unexpected conversations that unlock a hard problem, which happen because we are in the same room. Being together is not a formality, it is how we do our best work, and it is something we actively protect. When working from home makes more sense for what you need to get done that day, we trust you to make that call. Why Dust The models are powerful enough. What's missing is the product layer where AI meets how companies actually work. That's what we're building: the infrastructure that lets any team turn scattered knowledge and tools into coordinated execution with agents they build, own, and run themselves. We use Dust ourselves every day. We get to shape how humans and agents collaborate while solving our own problems with the product we ship. That loop is rare, and it's why we move fast. If you're excited about defining a new category and want to join a determined team of optimists who focus on users, ship fast, and don't take themselves too seriously, we'd love to talk. With 70%+ weekly active users, people stick with Dust as much as they do with Slack and Notion. We don't get piloted and shelved. We land once, and spread. We're at an exciting stage of our journey, and growing fast.

We're serving great customers like Datadog, 1Password, Cursor, Clay, Vanta and Persona, and aim to x5 our growth by the end of 2026.

Dust is backed by Sequoia with a determined team of optimists (coming from Stripe, OpenAI, and Stanford) who like to focus on users, ship fast, and don't take themselves too seriously while doing so. The Generalist named us among the Future 50.

This Role

The French market is one of Dust’s most important growth levers, and the Marketing team plays a central role in supporting pipeline generation through events, content and account-based activations.

As field marketing specialist, France, you will be the execution owner for Dust’s local Marketing activities. Working closely with the France Marketing Lead, you will turn defined priorities into high-quality events, localized webinars, social media, content and partner marketing activations that support Sales, BDRs and pipeline generation.

The France Marketing Lead owns the strategy, budget, programme selection and priorities. You will own execution, coordination, content delivery and continuous improvement across the French Marketing motion.

You will be part of a growing Marketing team across the US, UK and France, managed by the Global Head of Marketing.

Key Responsibilities

Own the execution of the French event and webinar programme

  • Execute conferences, Dust-owned events and localized webinars selected and scoped by the France Marketing Lead.

  • Coordinate the preparation, stakeholders, content, landing pages and logistics needed for a smooth delivery.

  • Work closely with Sales and BDRs to prepare target accounts, follow-up plans and event-related content.

  • Collect feedback, measure performance and document learnings after each activity.

Own French social media and content activation

  • Own social media execution for Dust around events, campaigns and key French-market topics.

  • Support AEs with relevant content and messaging for their LinkedIn activity.

  • Coordinate with Global Marketing, Product, Customer Success, Design and external media partners to deliver relevant content for French enterprise audiences.

  • Turn events, customer conversations and market insights into reusable content, including customer stories, blog posts, videos, YouTube content and Sales assets.

Support partner marketing and Growth programmes

  • Provide execution and logistical support for regional partner marketing activities within the strategy, selection and budget defined by the France Marketing Lead.

  • Support Growth with French-market content for ABM, webinars and paid campaigns.

  • Produce or reformat assets such as e-books, landing pages, customer content and campaign materials.

  • Connect event, content and partner marketing activities to target account engagement and pipeline generation.

Coordinate cross-functional Marketing initiatives

  • Identify opportunities to automate repetitive Marketing tasks , Build Dust agents and workflows to support research, event preparation, content repurposing, Sales enablement, reporting and follow-up.

  • Generalist and hands-on approach. You are comfortable moving between event ownership, content creation, Sales preparation, webinars, campaign assets and operational coordination.

Location

We're prioritizing building our team with an in-person culture at our offices in Paris, London, San Francisco, and New York because we value the magic that happens when talented people work closely together.

We have an office-first culture. Some of the best things about building at Dust are the energy, the fast decisions, and the unexpected conversations that unlock a hard problem, which happen because we are in the same room. Being together is not a formality, it is how we do our best work, and it is something we actively protect.

That said, we hire people with strong judgement and we extend that trust to how they manage their time. When working from home makes more sense for what you need to get done that day, we trust you to make that call.

The models are powerful enough. What's missing is the product layer where AI meets how companies actually work. That's what we're building: the infrastructure that lets any team turn scattered knowledge and tools into coordinated execution with agents they build, own, and run themselves.

You'll have the opportunity to become one of the most modern Sales professionals in the market! ⭐ You will be a great fit for this role if you: Have 1-2 years of experience in a Sales role including closing experience Have full working proficiency in French (C2 and above), and advanced level in English Are highly organized with exceptional follow-up skills Show a great balance between Active Listening and Assertiveness when interacting with your prospects Have natural empathy and are passionate about understanding and solving prospects' problems Have a positive attitude and ability to collaborate in a small team Have a desire to learn fast and make an impact from day 1 Are based in (or willing to relocate to) Paris, Bordeaux, Marseille, Lyon, Annecy, Nantes or Biarritz. For this opportunity, we are aiming to hire within the A2-B1 level range . Everything else is a plus. Amazing office space at our Paris HQ or sponsored co-working hubs in Bordeaux, Marseille, Lyon, Annecy, Nantes or Biarritz. All the tools you need . Top of the range equipment: Macbook Air, keyboard, laptop stand, monitor, and Bose noise-canceling headphones. Flexible vacation policy and flexible working hours . Organize your time as you wish. Delightful healthcare insurance: Extremely comprehensive health insurance - 100% for you and your children, 90-100% for partners depending on your country (permanent contracts only). Transport .   • A site or contract manager at an FM service provider (healthcare accounts) who wants to move in-house, or a Workplace / Facility Manager in a scale-up who has led several office openings or moves

  • Proven experience of opening or fitting out sites: works follow-up with architects, project managers and contractors, planning, acceptance, snags

  • Knowledge of the French regulatory framework for public-access buildings (ERP classification, safety commission, works authorisation, accessibility, mandatory periodic checks, safety register)

  • Proven vendor and contract management (SLAs, penalties, price indexation, tenders, invoice control) and budget ownership (capex / opex per site, total cost of ownership)

raw.title: Workplace Experience - Facility Manager in Paris
raw.description:
Health can’t wait.

Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t.

Alan exists to end the wait.

Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way.

So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience.

We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture. We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR.

Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 1000+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond.

Facility Manager — Hard FM

People joining Alan are often surprised and delighted by our innovative working method. We have a set of cultural values that guide our approach to work, such as:

 

🎯 What drives us — We're obsessed with helping our members live healthier

  • Mission is the Boss: long-term thinking, seeking our mission success above all else.

  • Member & customer-led: obsessively focused on solving members & customers problems and creating the most delightful experiences.

     

🏆 How we build excellence — We hire the best people and give them platform to succeed

  • Champions of excellence: extremely high standards and talent density.

  • Distributed ownership: accountable enlightened despots, everyone owns their decisions and results.

  • Radically transparent: all information is accessible and written-first, so everyone can make the best decisions asynchronously.

     

🤝 How we grow together — We help each other improve through honest feedback and bold thinking

  • Optimistic alchemy: optimists who collaborate with genuine care and support teammates.

  • Empathetic challengers: direct, caring feedback combined with praises to help each other grow professionally.

  • Bold & creative contrarians: think differently to achieve greatness, try new approaches.

⚡ How we move fast — We fight complexity and focus on what matters most

  • Disciplined in execution: taking decisive actions with focus that compounds success over time.

  • Fight for simplicity: only high impact processes, smart frugality.

     

💡 The Missions

Alan has grown to more than 1,000 Alaners, with 600+ hires expected in 2026 alone.

The Workplace team is the engine behind the experience Alaners have every day, and that experience starts with a building that simply works: safe, comfortable, compliant, with air that is good to breathe and doors that open when they should.

As the company scales, our technical footprint grows with it.

Today, technical maintenance at our Paris HQ (Valmy) relies on a part-time factotum and on team members who handle it on top of some other scopes.

We are opening a dedicated, full-time Facility Manager position to give more love to our offices and to anticipate needs. The first focus is the run at Valmy (our HQ), with a strong prevention mindset.

As Alan keeps growing, more real-estate projects are likely (new floors, a possible office move, sites abroad...): we expect you to grow into the technical lead on them.

The role is part of the Workplace team and covers a single contract: Workplace Experience. The position is based in Paris and requires an onsite presence at least 4 days per week.

👀 The profile we're looking for (level range targeted on our level grid: B1-C1)

Specific missions

  • Make prevention the heart of the role. Identify the main risk areas (HVAC, water leaks, fire safety, access control). Build and run the preventive maintenance calendar, plan the mandatory periodic checks and keep the safety register up to date.

  • Do regular office rounds with the Valmy services team to spot wear and risks (leaks, lighting, HVAC, doors, badge readers, fire safety) before Alaners report them. Turn each finding into an action with an owner and a date.

  • Run day-to-day maintenance. Sort and diagnose Alaners' requests and fix small issues directly yourself (e.g. changing a light bulb). Send the rest to the right contractor, and follow each intervention until the work is done and checked on site.

  • Be the single technical point of contact for our vendors and our landlord. This covers contracts and SLAs (agreed service levels and intervention times), invoice checks, tenders, and escalation of building-level issues under the lease.

  • Own the legal and financial side of FM, with Legal and Finance: regulatory compliance (ERP / labor code safety rules, mandatory checks, audit findings), lease obligations, and the maintenance budget (opex / capex) with monthly cost follow-up and optimization.

  • Keep our offices safe, healthy and comfortable for all Alaners, in line with our Healthy Business positioning (air quality, thermal comfort, fire safety, accessibility...).

  • Track, improve and document. Create and run a simple dashboard (open requests, intervention times, recurring issues, budget), keep the equipment inventory and maintenance log, automate repetitive follow-ups with AI and tools, and write procedures that can be reused for new floors and sites.

  • Own Alan's obligations under the Décret tertiaire (energy-reduction law for office buildings over 1,000 m²) at Valmy and future offices, with the landlords.

  • Cover the technical needs and follow-up required at the Prévenir medical center hosted at Valmy

  • Over time, lead the technical side of our real-estate projects (floor take-overs, office moves, new sites): technical checks of buildings, follow-up of works with architects and project managers, move planning.

  • Work daily with cross-functional teams: Legal (compliance, lease), Finance (budget, invoicing, cost optimization), IT (network, access control, room equipment) and Security (office safety policies, crisis reaction).

  • Join the on-call rotation (daily Office Management tasks).

Key outcomes by 1 year

  • All hard FM contracts are mapped, documented and tracked (scope, SLAs, renewal and exit dates, costs, mandatory checks): no missed regulatory check or expired contract

  • A preventive maintenance plan is live at Valmy, and the share of corrective / emergency interventions has measurably decreased

  • At least 3 prevention areas identified, each with a specific action plan and clear KPIs

  • Regulatory compliance is up to date: safety register complete, periodic checks done on time, audit findings closed

  • New fire safety equipment provider selected and onboarded

  • Air quality measured on all floors, issues diagnosed and a corrective action plan delivered

  • Led at least two vendor reviews or tenders, produced clear findings and took the corresponding decisions autonomously

  • An FM dashboard tracks service quality, vendor performance and budget consumption; at least 3 manual or recurring tasks automated

  • A replicable FM playbook and a building technical checklist exist, ready to be used for a new floor, an office move or a new site

You may be a great fit if you are:

  • A Facility Manager / Technical Manager with 3–6 years of experience on multi-technical (tertiary / office) buildings, in-house at a scale-up or large company

  • Coming from an FM service provider or a property manager (site manager, contract manager) and wanting to move in-house and own the client side

  • A multi-technical maintenance profile (HVAC, electrical, fire safety) who has grown into vendor management, budget ownership and compliance

  • A Workplace manager with an FM scope, or a works / fit-out project manager with solid maintenance and run experience

What we're looking for

  • Solid technical understanding of building systems: HVAC, electrical, plumbing, fire safety systems (alarm, extinguishers, emergency lighting), doors and access control

  • Knowledge of the French regulatory framework for offices (ERP / labor code safety rules, mandatory periodic checks, safety register, safety commission)

  • Proven vendor and contract management: SLAs, penalties, price indexation, tenders, invoice control

  • Ability to manage the landlord relationship and understand lease obligations (who pays and does what)

  • Electrical habilitation (mandatory, as the role fixes small electrical issues directly)

  • Exceptional communication in French (fluent) and professional English

  • Attention to detail, strong problem-solving, and the ability to juggle priorities, including urgent incidents, with a calm and constructive attitude when things go wrong (leak, outage, alarm)

  • A prevention mindset, autonomy and strong accountability: you spot what can be improved before being asked

  • A member-first mindset: you think about the Alaner experience, not the process

  • Appetite for digital tools, AI and basic automation to reduce repetitive work (ticketing, maintenance tracking, dashboards), and the ability to document in a way the whole team and AI agents can leverage

Nice to have

  • A technical diploma or certification (e.g. BTS / DUT in building maintenance or energy, SSIAP)

  • Experience with indoor air quality or energy efficiency projects (sensors, ventilation, Décret tertiaire)

  • Experience with a CMMS / GMAO tool, or building one with no-code tools

  • Experience leveraging AI to build scalable processes or automate recurring tasks

  • Experience in a high-growth tech company or scale-up

  • Having followed or led a fit-out, an office move or a new-site opening

 

🙌 Perks & Benefits


At Alan, we believe that being in good health is a basic need, and it starts with our employees. This is why Alaners are provided with a stimulating environment and perks ensuring they are happy, efficient and spend only high-quality time with co-workers.

Therefore, we offer:

  • All the tools you need. Top of the range equipment: Macbook Pro, keyboard, laptop stand, monitor, and Bose noise-canceling headphones.

  • Flexible vacation policy and flexible working hours. Organize your time as you wish.

  • Transport. Country-specific commuter benefits.

  • Personal growth through coaching: At Alan, coaching isn't just a perk - it's core to who we are. Every Alaner is paired with a dedicated coach from day one, who helps maximize their impact, nurture engagement, and navigate Alan's values to develop their full potential. Learn more about our coaching culture.

  • Learning & Training opportunities. A highly flexible Training policy free books and budget to attend and speak at conferences if the opportunity arises.

  • Fair rewards. Generous equity packages complement your base salary.

  • Delightful healthcare insurance. Extremely comprehensive health insurance - 100% of the contribution covered by Alan for you and your family.

  • Parental leave. Extended parental leave for all new parents.

 

Important note: we hire people, not roles.

If you're excited about this opportunity but don't check every box, we'd love to hear from you. Everyone, no matter how underrepresented, should feel free to apply as it can only bring learnings or success.

If you identify yourself as a woman: Did you know that research shows women often apply only when meeting 100% of requirements?

Remember, this is just a guide, not a checklist.


We'll be thrilled to receive your application!


🔖 Check out our About Alan and Career pages, as well as our Medium, blog and Glassdoor page for more info.

title: Data analist Lenen, Sparen & Retailbeleggen
description: De afdeling Lenen, Sparen en Retailbeleggen (LSR) houdt toezicht op financiële producten en diensten voor consumenten, zoals hypotheken, kredieten, sparen, betalen en beleggen. We zorgen dat informatie duidelijk is en dat online dienstverlening goed toegankelijk is. Samen zorgen we dat het klantbelang centraal staat, vooral voor kwetsbare groepen. Ons toezicht richt zich op het herkennen en aanpakken van risico’s voor consumenten. We willen dit zo snel en effectief mogelijk doen. Om meer impact te maken, gebruiken we data op een slimme manier. Daarbij zoeken we continu naar signalen, toetsen we aannames en brengen we risico’s en mogelijke blinde vlekken in beeld. Zo kunnen we sneller inspelen op veranderingen in de financiële sector. De vraagstukken waar je aan werkt zijn vaak nieuw, complex en actueel. Denk aan risico’s rond Buy Now Pay Later, online beleggingsplatformen, AI-toepassingen of ontwikkelingen in de cryptomarkt. Jouw analyses dragen direct bij aan keuzes die de AFM maakt in haar toezicht. Dit ga je doen: Samenwerken met toezichthouders om risico’s voor consumenten tijdig te signaleren. Ontwikkelen van dataproducten die inzichten vertalen naar gerichte acties. Implementeren van betrouwbare en schaalbare oplossingen voor effectiever toezicht. Visualiseren van resultaten in dashboards die toezichthouders ondersteunen. Kansen signaleren om processen slimmer in te richten en repetitief werk te automatiseren. Experimenteren met nieuwe technieken zoals AI om toezicht slimmer, sneller en effectiever te maken. Team Team Data Analyse & Innovatie is één van de vijf teams binnen de afdeling LSR. Dit team is verantwoordelijk voor het verder ontwikkelen en uitvoeren van de Datagedreven Toezicht Strategie (DGT) van LSR. Dit betekent dat het team toezichtsvragen vertaalt naar oplossingen met data. We bouwen aan een stevige basis en een duidelijke planning (roadmap) voor de hele afdeling. Ook helpt het team om data echt te gaan gebruiken in het toezicht. Zo kunnen we straks beter controleren of instellingen zich aan de regels houden, risico’s inschatten en slimme technologie zoals AI inzetten om ons werk sneller en efficiënter te maken. Ook kijkt het team naar risico’s van nieuwe technologie in de financiële sector. Zo spelen we een belangrijke rol in het tijdig herkennen van risico’s. De deadline voor deze vacature is 25 november 2026. Dit vragen we: ⭐ Een afgeronde WO-opleiding, bijvoorbeeld Data Science, Business Analytics, Wiskunde, Econometrie, Technische Bedrijfskunde of een vergelijkbare (bèta) studie met een sterke analytische of statistische component. ⭐ Minimaal 2 jaar werkervaring en kennis van het data/science werkveld en de daarbij behorende tools en technieken. Hierbij is ervaring met Microsoft Power BI, SQL, Python, Azure Data Bricks een vereiste. ⭐Kennis van softwareontwikkeling, versiebeheer, codereview en unit testing is vereist. ⭐ Analytisch sterk: het vermogen om complexe datasets te analyseren, patronen te herkennen en inzichten te genereren. Je neemt informatie niet zonder meer aan, toetst aannames en identificeert risico’s, afwijkingen en mogelijke blinde vlekken. ⭐ Proactieve houding: je werkt graag samen en draagt bij aan het gezamenlijke succes, tegelijkertijd kan je zelfstandig knopen doorhakken en analyses omzetten in concrete en bruikbare uitkomsten. ⭐ Communicatieve vaardigheden: je kunt complexe technische informatie helder en beknopt overbrengen aan niet of minder-technische collega’s. Ervaring met datavisualisatie om gegevens begrijpelijk en toegankelijk te presenteren voor verschillende belanghebbenden. Please note: excellent proficiency in Dutch, both verbal and written, is required for this position. Wat wij bieden: 📄 Je start met een jaarcontract met uitzicht op een vast dienstverband 💰 Afhankelijk van kennis en ervaring word je ingeschaald in schaal F (junior, met een bruto jaarsalaris tussen €52.500 en €87.000) of schaal G (medior, met een bruto jaarsalaris tussen €62.000 en €103.500). Bedragen zijn op basis van een 36-urige werkweek, inclusief 13e maand en vakantiegeld ⏰ 36-urige werkweek, werkdagen in overleg (bijv. 4x9) 🌴 199,5 vakantie-uren per jaar (bovenop je standaard roostervrije dag) 💻 Een laptop en een smartphone 📚 Uitgebreide trainings- en opleidingsmogelijkheden 🚆 Volledige vergoeding van OV-reiskosten (2e klas) 🏡 Thuiswerkvergoeding voor thuiswerkdagen 💪 Bijdrage aan een sportschoolabonnement 🚲 Aantrekkelijke secundaire arbeidsvoorwaarden zoals een fiets- en deviceregeling en vergoeding voor je thuiswerkplek Meer informatie? Voor vragen over de vacature neem je contact op met Megan van Rooij (recruiter) via Find Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

De vraagstukken waar je aan werkt zijn vaak nieuw, complex en actueel. Denk aan risico’s rond Buy Now Pay Later, online beleggingsplatformen, AI-toepassingen of ontwikkelingen in de cryptomarkt. Jouw analyses dragen direct bij aan keuzes die de AFM maakt in haar toezicht.

Team
Team Data Analyse & Innovatie is één van de vijf teams binnen de afdeling LSR. Dit team is verantwoordelijk voor het verder ontwikkelen en uitvoeren van de Datagedreven Toezicht Strategie (DGT) van LSR.

 

Dit betekent dat het team toezichtsvragen vertaalt naar oplossingen met data. We bouwen aan een stevige basis en een duidelijke planning (roadmap) voor de hele afdeling. Ook helpt het team om data echt te gaan gebruiken in het toezicht. Zo kunnen we straks beter controleren of instellingen zich aan de regels houden, risico’s inschatten en slimme technologie zoals AI inzetten om ons werk sneller en efficiënter te maken. Ook kijkt het team naar risico’s van nieuwe technologie in de financiële sector. Zo spelen we een belangrijke rol in het tijdig herkennen van risico’s.
