Du studierst und willst mehr als einen „Nebenjob“? Du willst Verantwortung, klare Ziele und ein Umfeld, in dem Leistung zählt? Dann ist diese Werkstudentenrolle dein Einstieg in die Finanzberatung, mit strukturiertem Onboarding, Coaching und einem klaren Weg in ein Trainee-Programm.

Diese Rolle ist unternehmerisch geprägt und bietet dir die Möglichkeit, dich aktiv einzubringen, Verantwortung zu übernehmen und dich fachlich wie persönlich weiterzuentwickeln. Leistung und Eigeninitiative spielen dabei eine zentrale Rolle, gleichzeitig wirst du durch strukturiertes Onboarding, Coaching und ein erfahrenes Team unterstützt.

Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse (C1+) sind erforderlich, da die Ausbildung, die Kommunikation im Team sowie die Perspektive Richtung IHK vollständig auf Deutsch stattfinden.

Dein Aufgabenbereich

Startphase (erste Wochen):

  • Terminaufbau: Du vereinbarst Kundentermine (Telefon, Netzwerk, Leads) und baust eine saubere Pipeline auf.

  • Prozesslernen: Du lernst Gesprächsleitfäden, Bedarfsermittlung, Nachbereitung und Dokumentationsstandards.

  • Performance-Optimierung: Du arbeitest mit KPIs, bekommst Feedback und verbesserst systematisch deine Ergebnisse.

Im weiteren Verlauf:

  • Analyse & Vorbereitung: Du unterstützt bei der Analyse von Kundensituationen und bereitest Beratungsunterlagen strukturiert vor.

  • Kundenkontakt: Du begleitest Gespräche (je nach Stand), übernimmst Follow-ups und sorgst für klare nächste Schritte.

  • Dokumentation & Organisation: Du hältst Prozesse sauber, dokumentierst konsequent und stellst Verlässlichkeit sicher.

  • Teamarbeit: Du arbeitest eng mit einem leistungsstarken Team und übernimmst Verantwortung für deine Aufgabenpakete.

Das bieten wir dir

  • Strukturierter Einstieg: Trainingsplan, Leitfäden, klare Standards

  • Mentoring & Coaching: regelmäßiges Feedback, klare Ziele

  • Leistungsorientierte Vergütung (Erfolgslogik – du wirst für Output belohnt)

  • Skalierbare Perspektive: Option auf Übernahme ins Trainee-Programm

  • Remote möglich – eigenverantwortlich statt “nach Uhr”

  • Team mit Performance-Kultur: klare Kommunikation, klare Ergebnisse


Nichts für dich, wenn…

  • du einen typischen Werkstudentenjob mit “ein paar Stunden nebenbei” suchst

  • du Telefon/Terminaufbau vermeiden willst

  • dein Deutsch unter C1 liegt

  • du lieber Sicherheit als Entwicklung priorisierst

Muss

  • Immatrikuliert (Uni/FH)

  • Deutsch mindestens C1 (mündlich & schriftlich)

  • Kommunikationsstärke, Verbindlichkeit, Zuverlässigkeit

  • Eigeninitiative und strukturierte Arbeitsweise

  • Lust auf Leistung und messbare Ergebnisse

Wunsch

  • Erste Erfahrung in Vertrieb, Service, Beratung, Sport-/Leistungskultur

raw.title: IoT Embedded Systems Engineer
raw.description:
• Take ownership of the development of IoT systems, with a focus on embedded software, system architecture, and hardware and firmware integration

  • Design and develop robust, efficient, and scalable embedded software for IoT products based on microcontroller platforms and, optionally, Linux based systems

  • Provide technical guidance for hardware development in collaboration with external partners, including reviewing and challenging PCB designs to ensure functionality, quality, and manufacturability

  • Collaborate closely with mechanical, software, and cloud engineering teams to ensure seamless end to end system integration

  • Define and refine product requirements from initial concept through to mass production in collaboration with internal and external stakeholders

  • Develop and integrate prototypes and support the transition from development into serial production together with manufacturing partners

  • Contribute to the continuous evolution of the embedded platform, including MCU based solutions as well as optional Linux and Yocto based components

  • Develop pragmatic testing strategies to ensure the functionality, reliability, and quality of both hardware and firmware

  • Support development and manufacturing partners with debugging, technical documentation, and production ramp up

  • Provide Level 3 technical support for complex system, firmware, and hardware related issues

  • Travel approximately 5 to 10 percent to support development partners, product validation activities, and product launches


  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Embedded Systems, Computer Science, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience

  • Several years of hands on experience in embedded development, including firmware development and hardware related engineering

  • Strong understanding of hardware design and PCB layouts, with the ability to review design decisions and collaborate effectively with hardware development teams

  • Strong expertise in embedded firmware development and software architecture for microcontroller platforms such as ARM Cortex, ESP32, or STM32

  • Experience with sensor integration and wireless communication technologies such as BLE and WiFi

  • Experience with embedded Linux systems, particularly Yocto, is an advantage, especially in environments combining System on Modules with MCU based architectures

  • Broad system level understanding of mechanics, sensors, actuators, and their integration into robust IoT products

  • Hands on experience with hardware testing, debugging tools, and automated production testing

  • Familiarity with certification standards such as CE and FCC is an advantage

  • Fluent in German and English, with additional languages considered a plus

title: Product Designer (m/f/x)
description: UP42 was founded in 2019 with a clear purpose: to transform how organizations order, access, and analyze Earth observation data. Our platform brings together the world’s leading geospatial providers, and offers a single touchpoint to access, manage, and process data at scale. From vegetation management and infrastructure monitoring to disaster response, UP42 helps organizations across industries find solutions to complex problems through Earth observation. Our expert support team and detailed documentation guide our users through every step. Since July 2025, UP42 has been a part of Neo Space Group. We are looking for a Product Designer (m/f/x) to join our Design Team in Berlin. You will be the design partner for one of our product teams, working alongside a Product Manager and engineers to take work from an early idea through to something people use. You will own your projects, hold a high quality bar on complex, data-rich interfaces, and work inside a design system you help keep healthy. You will enjoy this role if you want real ownership of a product area without carrying a whole platform, and if you like going deep into a genuinely complex domain. Our team is complementary, so your work is visible and the feedback loop is short. What you will do: Take design work from an early idea through to delivery, proposing solutions to blockers rather than only reporting them. Be the reliable design partner for your product team: the person your PM and engineers come to first. Design for complexity: dense data tables, long-running processes, and workflows where the edge cases matter as much as the main path. Look for evidence before you design: talk to users, read what support and sales already know, look at how the product is actually used, and run tests on your own work. Push to understand the problem before designing a solution, and say so when a brief arrives already shaped as one. Scope your own features, break them into pieces, be roughly right about how long they will take, and flag delays early with a plan B rather than a warning. Contribute to our design system, as everyone on our team does: propose and build components, not only use them. Share your work cross-functionally, take feedback, and iterate; notice improvements inside your area and act on them, instead of waiting to be asked. Here is a good summary of what we are looking for: Experience delivering product design work end-to-end inside a cross-functional team. Solid interaction (IxD) and visual/UI design skills, with the ability to make complex data and workflows understandable. Strong Figma skills, and a working understanding of how a design system is actually built: how a component is structured, how it behaves, and the rules it has to respect. You will be a contributor to ours, not only a user of it. Experience using research and product evidence to make design decisions: usability tests, customer conversations, support tickets, product data. We are not looking for one particular method. Comfortable telling the difference between what we know and what we are assuming, and willing to say which is which. Comfortable with ambiguity: able to make progress when the picture is still incomplete, and to adjust when what you learn changes the direction. Able to scope your own work and communicate honestly about time, collaborative, feedback-driven, and proactive about the problems you can see. Fluent in English and based in Berlin with hybrid work capability. Bonus points if you bring: Experience designing geospatial, enterprise, or data-heavy B2B products. Background in UX research, data visualization, or complex workflow design. Knowledge of accessibility and inclusive design. Experience with interactive prototyping. Awareness of current AI tools and emerging opportunities in UX processes, with an understanding of how AI can enhance user outcomes without adding unnecessary complexity. Let us tell you why UP42 is a good choice: Let’s disrupt the industry: You get the chance to shape the state-of-the-art geospatial processing platform and create a completely new planetary perspective Let’s stay flexible: We practice a hybrid working model - you can choose when to work from the comfort of your home or join your colleagues in our modern office in the heart of Kreuzberg, or even from a global place of your choice up to 90 days per year Let’s win as a team: We’re an inspiring international team working in a fun and productive environment Let’s be fair: We offer a competitive salary package and other perks such as wellbeing initiatives, sponsored fitness subscriptions, an educational budget for your personal development and public transportation discount - just to name a few Let’s enjoy the good side of life: Gather in regular team events as well as our global company parties twice a year Let’s think outside of the box: There are challenges and enough space for creativity and taking ownership Does this sound like a good next step into your geospatial career? If so, we look forward to receiving your application in English. Our culture is one of belonging, where everyone feels welcome and where differences are celebrated. We seek to recruit the best talent regardless of age, gender, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, socio-economic background and/or belief—and strongly encourage people from underrepresented groups to apply. We also value more than the skills and experiences outlined in this job description. Even if you think you only fill 60% of the requirements for this role - we would still like to consider your application. Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Cloud Engineer
description: At Luscii, we're creating space for care by developing and improving digital healthcare applications that make a real difference in people's lives through several applications. From Luscii Thuismeten, which helps healthcare professionals monitor patients remotely, to OMRON Connect, connecting millions of people with their health data through OMRON devices, and other applications that expand the possibilities of digital healthcare. Together with healthcare professionals and partners around the world, we're working towards a future where people receive the right care in the right place. As our Senior Cloud Engineer, you'll help shape and modernise the cloud infrastructure behind these applications, building a reliable, scalable and future-proof foundation for millions of users worldwide. Our applications have different histories, architectures and technical challenges. OMRON Connect, for example, runs on an AWS backend serving several million monthly active users. Parts of its infrastructure still carry legacy, including manual processes, scattered knowledge, inconsistent observability and release processes that make changes slower and riskier than they should be. We're working towards a more consistent engineering foundation across our applications. Think Infrastructure as Code, cloud-native and event-driven architecture where it adds value, safe continuous deployment and observability by default. We're bringing more senior engineering expertise in-house to turn that ambition into concrete technical decisions, shared standards and a roadmap our teams can own. And that's where you come in 😉 Your role You will work across our engineering teams, helping shape the cloud infrastructure behind our digital healthcare applications. Your focus will be on making the right architectural decisions, modernising existing platforms and enabling teams to independently build, maintain and improve their systems. This isn't a greenfield architecture exercise. You will be improving live healthcare platforms while balancing technical improvements with product delivery, security, regulatory requirements and the realities of working with stakeholders across different countries, including the Netherlands and Japan. What you will be doing, among others: Own and evolve the Cloud & Backend roadmap, translating the engineering vision into clear priorities, trade-offs and next steps. Drive cross-team architecture decisions to a close, making sure decisions are transparent, documented and followed through. Establish shared technical standards and guardrails that allow teams to work autonomously without creating unnecessary dependencies. Work hands-on with engineers on AWS and Terraform, reviewing designs and pull requests and challenging technical choices where needed. Coach and pair with engineers, helping knowledge spread across teams and supporting the growth of seniority and ownership. Work with product owners, QA, engineering leadership and colleagues in Japan to balance technical direction with product, regulatory, security and cost considerations. Help move the platform towards automated infrastructure, safer deployments and stronger observability without relying on a big-bang rewrite. The responsibilities outlined above reflect how we currently envision this role. As we continue to grow and evolve, the scope and focus of the position may naturally change, influenced by your own ideas and insights. The way we work is built around the belief that everyone's input matters. If you see opportunities to improve the way we do things, or believe a process could be designed differently to achieve a better outcome, we encourage you to bring those ideas forward. Discuss them with your teammates, challenge the status quo, and help shape how we move forward together. Why Luscii? Read more about working at Luscii / OMRON and how we work as a team. Together, we are working on a mission to create space for care. Freedom, autonomy and ownership are of great importance in this. You are responsible for your own results and work according to the principles of Holacracy. Luscii is part of OMRON DH ; together we built for the long term. To work on making healthcare better. Most important benefits Salary : An annual maximum remuneration of approximately € 85.000 gross per year is estimated for this position (based on 32 hours per week – that’s full-time at Luscii), depending on the interviews, your experience, background and knowledge. Remote-first : Work from anywhere in The Netherlands. We stay connected through monthly in-person team days called Assemblii . Flexible setup : Create your own ideal workspace. Whatever works best for you - we’ve got you covered here. We do work from Mondays to Thursdays, as 32 hours per week is fulltime. The ideal candidate… … probably doesn't exist, but if you can tick most of the checkboxes below, please apply! We are looking for someone who enjoys taking ownership of complex technical challenges, makes pragmatic engineering decisions, and is excited about helping others succeed along the way. You know when to step up, when to involve colleagues and when to move forward decisively. Working independently does not mean working in isolation for you. You feel at ease being both a self-starter and a committed team player, contributing to shared goals while taking responsibility for your own domain. You value open communication, transparency, and mutual trust. You have at least 5+ years of experience in cloud/backend engineering and multiple years of hands-on experience with AWS and Terraform (Infrastructure as Code). You are comfortable reviewing designs and pull requests. Experience with serverless and event-driven architectures is very valuable. All combined with experience in serverless AWS, Node.js/TypeScript tech stacks. You actively coach, pair, review and share knowledge, with a focus on building ownership and seniority across the teams around you. You understand what matters: the importance of making pragmatic technical choices within clear security, compliance and regulatory boundaries. You are open to working in a Holacratic organization and curious about our way of organizing work, roles, and responsibilities; English is our primary language for all internal communication at Luscii, so you're fluent in that language. Interested? Apply now! Would you like more information? Feel free to contact our recruiter Björn Bogerd via What does the recruitment process look like? We organise three interviews for each vacancy. It is an extensive process, but we want to ensure that there is a good fit in regards to a potential collaboration, our culture and our way of working. All interviews are conducted online and the entire procedure is planned in advance to keep momentum. Find Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

title: Meewerk Stage Continuous Improvement (Power BI & Power Automate)
description: Ben jij analytisch sterk en wil je impact maken binnen een internationale organisatie? Dan moeten we jou hebben! Jouw rol Bij Heras krijg je de kans om als stagiair bij te dragen aan het Nimble-programma: een strategisch verbeterprogramma gericht op het vereenvoudigen en automatiseren van bedrijfsprocessen. Als stagiair werk je aan het verbeteren van processen binnen domeinen zoals sales, projecten in nieuwbouw en finance. Je analyseert hoe processen vandaag werken en vertaalt dit naar slimme oplossingen met behulp van Power BI en Power Automate. Je levert concrete procesverbeteringen, procesbeschrijvingen, automatiseringen en Power BI dashboards voor operationele en financiële sturing aan alsmede werkende Power Automate flows. Tenslotte lever je een meetbare bijdrage aan efficiëntie (bijv. tijdbesparing of minder fouten). Jouw werkzaamheden In kaart brengen van huidige processen en knelpunten. Automatiseren van handmatige processen met Power Automate. Ontwikkelen van dashboards en rapportages in Power BI (zonder daadwerkelijk programmeren). Verbeteren van datakwaliteit en inzicht in KPI’s. Samenwerken met business teams en IT-specialisten. Benieuwd naar de ervaringen van een stagiair bij Heras? De eerste indruk: dynamisch in plaats van stoffig - Heras Nederland Wie zijn wij? Heras is een vooraanstaand Europese totaalleverancier van permanente perimeter protection oplossingen. Wij opereren vanuit meer dan 24 landen en hebben meer dan 1100 hoogopgeleide experts in dienst. raw.description:
1KOMMA5°

Bei 1KOMMA5° verfolgen wir eine Vision: Living on wind and sunlight forever for free. Dafür bauen wir mit Heartbeat AI das Energiesystem der Zukunft. Bist du dabei?
Wir bringen regionales Handwerk und skalierbare Software zusammen: Solar, Speicher, Wärmepumpe und E-Mobilität denken wir nicht einzeln, sondern steuern sie als intelligentes, integriertes Gesamtsystem in unserem virtuellen Kraftwerk. Direkt verbunden mit dem Strommarkt – in Echtzeit, vollautomatisiert. So wird Energie dann genutzt, wenn sie erneuerbar verfügbar und besonders günstig ist. Bis 2030 wollen wir 1,5 Millionen Haushalte auf erneuerbare Energien umstellen. Über 3.000 Menschen arbeiten jeden Tag daran, an mehr als 80 Standorten weltweit, von Finnland bis Australien.

Du willst Verantwortung übernehmen und Lösungen bauen, die wirklich zählen? Bewirb dich jetzt und gestalte mit uns die Energiewelt von morgen.

Deine Position

Für unser Grafik & Designteam suchen wir Unterstützung in Hamburg vorerst auf 2 Jahre befristet. Das sind deine Aufgaben:

  • Für unsere nationalen Standorte bist du erste Ansprechperson wenn es um die Kreation von benötigten Grafiken geht
  • Du setzt Flyer, Einladungen, Anzeigen, Werbemittel, Poster, Standortbrandings uvm. nach unseren CI-Richtlinien um
  • Dabei arbeitest du eng mit unserer Director Design und dem Rest des Design Teams der 1KOMMA5° Holding zusammen
  • Du erstellst und adaptierst praktische Design-Vorlagen, die von den Standorten teilweise auch selbst genutzt werden können und stellst damit eine zügige Umsetzung sicher
  • Dabei agierst du auch als CI Polizei und stellst sicher, dass Grafiken standort- und kanalübergreifend von ansässigen Designern oder Marketeers korrekt umgesetzt werden
  • Du wirst zudem als genereller Grafik Support für diverse Designprojekte innerhalb der Holding eingesetzt
  • Du bist im regelmäßigen Austausch mit dem Brand-Content-Team und unterstützenden Dienstleistern

Dein Profil

  • Du verfügst über eine abgeschlossene Ausbildung oder ein Studium in Kommunikationsdesign/ Grafikdesign/ Mediengestaltung oder besitzt eine vergleichbare Qualifikation
  • Du konntest bereits erste Berufserfahrung sammeln und aktiv Projekte umsetzen (mind. 1,5-2 Jahre)
  • Du besitzt sehr gute Kenntnisse in Adobe Creative Suite (InDesign, Illustrator, Photoshop und Lightroom) sowie MS Office-Programmen
  • Erfahrungen im Print Grafik Bereich und mit dem Tool FIGMA sind sehr willkommen
  • Du hast ein gutes Gespür für Typografie, Ästhetik und Trends und besitzt Kreativität und Weitblick
  • Eine selbstständige und strukturierte Arbeitsweise kombiniert mit absoluter Teamfähigkeit sind für dich Standard
  • Du bringst sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift mit und kommunizierst gerne mit anderen Menschen
  • Du kannst mit Zeitdruck umgehen und hältst dich an Deadlines und Vorgaben
  • Du liebst es, deine Arbeit zu dokumentieren und eine saubere Ablage zu pflegen

Benefits

  • Du hast die Möglichkeit in unserem tollen Showroom in der Hamburger Innenstadt zu arbeiten direkt am Ballindamm.
  • Nutze dein technisches Equipment auch abseits der Arbeit in deiner Freizeit
  • Du bist Teil eines schnell wachsenden Unternehmens mit viel Entwicklungspotenzi al, wo du eigenständig etwas aufbauen kannst und deinen Impact spürst
  • Bewege dich in flachen Hierarchien, übernimm schon während deiner Einarbeitung Verantwortung und arbeite direkt mit Teilen des Managements zusammen
  • Mit deiner Arbeit unterstützt du den Megatrend “Energie- und Mobilitätswende” und leistest einen konkreten Beitrag zum nachhaltigen Umbau unserer Energie-Infrastruktur
  • Sei aktiv und nutze das Angebot von über 7.600 Sportpartnern mit dem EGYM-Wellpass
  • Ob Citybike oder E-Bike – mit unserem Jobrad-Leasing bleibst du flexibel und bist umweltfreundlich unterwegs
  • Profitiere von Benefits & Rabatten durch Futurebens

Compensation

  • Experience collaborating with NGA, NASIC, or other Intelligence Community organizations.

Du bist auffassungsstark, proaktiv und „machst“ Dinge, wo andere erstmal reden . title: Senior Product Engineer
description: Hey there! We’re Fever , the world’s leading tech platform for culture and live entertainment. Our mission? To democratize access to culture and entertainment. With our proprietary cutting-edge technology and data-driven approach, we’re revolutionizing the way people engage with live entertainment. Every month, our platform inspires over 300 million people in +55 countries (and counting) to discover unforgettable experiences while also empowering event creators with our data and technology, helping them scale, innovate, and enhance their events to reach new audiences. Our results? We’ve teamed up with major industry leaders like Netflix, F.C. Barcelona, and Primavera Sound, presented international award-winning experiences, and are backed by several leading global investors! Impressive, right? To achieve our mission, we are looking for bar-raisers with a hands-on mindset who are eager to help shape the future of entertainment! Ready to be part of the experience? Now, let’s discuss this role and what you will do to help achieve Fever’s mission. We are looking for a Senior Product Engineer to join our Data Team. This is a role for an engineer who cares deeply about product impact, user experience, and how systems connect to real business outcomes. You will work across the full stack, from the interfaces users interact with to the services and data layers that power them, and bridge the gap between our AI and data capabilities and the products people actually use. You won't just take tickets and ship code. You'll own features end-to-end: shaping the problem with Product and Design, building it, defining success metrics, and iterating based on real data. If you thrive in ambiguous, high-leverage environments, love shipping with judgment, and want your engineering work to be visibly tied to outcomes that matter, you'll fit right in. Tech environment This role is intentionally not defined by one framework or specialty. That said, you will likely operate across the full stack: a modern TypeScript web platform where several frontends and frameworks coexist, and where moving between them matters more than allegiance to one, that also ships inside our native apps through webviews and a native/web bridge; Python-based services and APIs; relational, NoSQL, and search datastores, data warehouses, and SQL; event-driven and distributed systems; cloud infrastructure, containers, and CI/CD pipelines; and observability tooling. Depending on the project, you may also work with LLM APIs and agent-based workflows, retrieval patterns, data orchestration, and product analytics and A/B experimentation. Nice to have Strong TypeScript and depth in at least one modern web framework. Our web platform is a large monorepo combining several frontends, where Angular and Astro/Svelte coexist. Comfort moving across frameworks matters more than allegiance to one. Strong componentization skills: designing reusable components and shared modules whose logic lives in framework-agnostic packages, including web features that ship inside our native apps through webviews and JavaScript/native bridges. Our apps are Kotlin/Jetpack Compose and Swift/SwiftUI; you won't own them, but you'll integrate deeply with them. Sound judgment on when to render server-side vs client-side (or hybrid), driven by functional and non-functional requirements such as SEO, performance, personalization, and caching, rather than framework defaults. Experience working on internal platforms, operational tools, or product-heavy backend systems. Experience with Python frameworks such as Django or FastAPI. Experience with PostgreSQL, Snowflake, DynamoDB, Redis, OpenSearch, and SQL-heavy applications. Familiarity with event-driven architectures or messaging systems such as Kafka or RabbitMQ. Experience with AWS, Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, or similar infrastructure patterns. Familiarity with observability and monitoring tooling (Datadog or similar). Exposure to AI-enabled product development: LLM integrations, agent frameworks (LangGraph/LangChain), LLM observability (Langfuse), RAG patterns, or workflow automation. Familiarity with Google Analytics 4 and Google Tag Manager. Product tracking at Fever runs through Dataverse, our in-house unified behavioural event layer built on server-side GTM, so knowing how GA and GTM work is enough to find your way around. We also use Mixpanel. Familiarity with product experimentation: A/B testing, feature flags, and edge-side experimentation. We bucket anonymous users and run rollouts at the CDN edge (CloudFront Functions), with Statsig and Optimizely as the experimentation platforms. Experience working on 0 to 1 initiatives or undefined problem spaces. Demonstrated leadership through ownership of difficult projects with broad impact. What success looks like You turn ambiguous opportunities into working systems or products that create clear value. You help teams make better trade-offs and avoid overengineering, fragmentation, and local optimization. You improve not only what gets built, but also how decisions are made. You become a trusted technical leader for important cross-functional initiatives. You increase the leverage of other engineers and teams through your judgment, technical direction, and execution support. You help connect engineering work to real operational and business outcomes. Who will thrive in this role You will likely thrive here if: You are energized by ambitious, messy, high-leverage problems. You like operating where priorities evolve and the path is not fully defined. You care more about impact than about staying inside a narrowly defined engineering lane. You enjoy combining engineering depth, product thinking, and business context. You naturally look for the highest-leverage way to move a system, a team, or a product forward. You want to play a meaningful role in shaping how the company builds and scales. Why join Fever You will work on some of the company's most strategic problems. You will have real ownership and visible impact. You will help shape products, systems, and capabilities that matter across the business. You will work in an environment that values ambition, adaptability, pragmatism, and execution. You will be surrounded by smart, driven people who care about building things that matter. Benefits & Perks Flexible schedule Bonus Stock options 40% discount on all Fever events and experiences Health insurance from Day 1 English or Spanish Lessons Wellhub Membership Cobee (tax free allowance on restaurants and transport) Possibility to receive in advance part of your salary by Payflow Thank you for considering joining Fever. We cannot wait to learn more about you! If you want to learn more about us: Fever's Blog | Tech.Eu | TechCrunch Fever is committed to creating an inclusive and diverse workspace where everyone's background and ideas count. Our main goal is to find the best possible talent regardless of place of birth, racial or ethnic origin, gender, gender identity, religion, opinion, sexual orientation, disability, pregnancy, marital status, age or caring responsibilities. We encourage everyone to apply! If you require any kind of accommodation during the selection process please contact our Talent team so we can help you by providing a welcoming and seamless journey. If you thrive in ambiguous, high-leverage environments, love shipping with judgment, and want your engineering work to be visibly tied to outcomes that matter, you'll fit right in.

Tech environment

This role is intentionally not defined by one framework or specialty. That said, you will likely operate across the full stack: a modern TypeScript web platform where several frontends and frameworks coexist, and where moving between them matters more than allegiance to one, that also ships inside our native apps through webviews and a native/web bridge; Python-based services and APIs; relational, NoSQL, and search datastores, data warehouses, and SQL; event-driven and distributed systems; cloud infrastructure, containers, and CI/CD pipelines; and observability tooling. Depending on the project, you may also work with LLM APIs and agent-based workflows, retrieval patterns, data orchestration, and product analytics and A/B experimentation.

Nice to have

  • Strong TypeScript and depth in at least one modern web framework. Our web platform is a large monorepo combining several frontends, where Angular and Astro/Svelte coexist. Comfort moving across frameworks matters more than allegiance to one.
  • Strong componentization skills: designing reusable components and shared modules whose logic lives in framework-agnostic packages, including web features that ship inside our native apps through webviews and JavaScript/native bridges. Our apps are Kotlin/Jetpack Compose and Swift/SwiftUI; you won't own them, but you'll integrate deeply with them.
  • Sound judgment on when to render server-side vs client-side (or hybrid), driven by functional and non-functional requirements such as SEO, performance, personalization, and caching, rather than framework defaults.
  • Experience working on internal platforms, operational tools, or product-heavy backend systems.
  • Experience with Python frameworks such as Django or FastAPI.
  • Experience with PostgreSQL, Snowflake, DynamoDB, Redis, OpenSearch, and SQL-heavy applications.
  • Familiarity with event-driven architectures or messaging systems such as Kafka or RabbitMQ.
  • Experience with AWS, Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, or similar infrastructure patterns.
  • Familiarity with observability and monitoring tooling (Datadog or similar).
  • Exposure to AI-enabled product development: LLM integrations, agent frameworks (LangGraph/LangChain), LLM observability (Langfuse), RAG patterns, or workflow automation.
  • Familiarity with Google Analytics 4 and Google Tag Manager. Product tracking at Fever runs through Dataverse, our in-house unified behavioural event layer built on server-side GTM, so knowing how GA and GTM work is enough to find your way around. We also use Mixpanel.
  • Familiarity with product experimentation: A/B testing, feature flags, and edge-side experimentation. We bucket anonymous users and run rollouts at the CDN edge (CloudFront Functions), with Statsig and Optimizely as the experimentation platforms.
  • Experience working on 0 to 1 initiatives or undefined problem spaces.
  • Demonstrated leadership through ownership of difficult projects with broad impact.

What success looks like

  • You turn ambiguous opportunities into working systems or products that create clear value.
  • You help teams make better trade-offs and avoid overengineering, fragmentation, and local optimization.
  • You improve not only what gets built, but also how decisions are made.
  • You become a trusted technical leader for important cross-functional initiatives.
  • You increase the leverage of other engineers and teams through your judgment, technical direction, and execution support.
  • You help connect engineering work to real operational and business outcomes.

Who will thrive in this role

You will likely thrive here if:

  • You are energized by ambitious, messy, high-leverage problems.
  • You like operating where priorities evolve and the path is not fully defined.
  • You care more about impact than about staying inside a narrowly defined engineering lane.
  • You enjoy combining engineering depth, product thinking, and business context.
  • You naturally look for the highest-leverage way to move a system, a team, or a product forward.
  • You want to play a meaningful role in shaping how the company builds and scales.

Why join Fever

  • You will work on some of the company's most strategic problems.
  • You will have real ownership and visible impact.
  • You will help shape products, systems, and capabilities that matter across the business.
  • You will work in an environment that values ambition, adaptability, pragmatism, and execution.
  • You will be surrounded by smart, driven people who care about building things that matter.

Benefits & Perks

  • Flexible schedule
  • Bonus
  • Stock options
  • 40% discount on all Fever events and experiences
  • Health insurance from Day 1
  • English or Spanish Lessons
  • Wellhub Membership

title: Staff Forward Deployed Engineer, EMEA
description: GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster. The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software. * Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab. An overview of this role GitLab’s Forward Deployed Engineering team is a field-situated product engineering function focused on strategic customer outcomes, artificial intelligence (AI) adoption, and direct contributions to GitLab’s product. This isn't a traditional field engineering, solutions architecture, or professional services role. As a Staff Forward Deployed Engineer, you'll work closely with customers while maintaining the technical standards and contribution discipline of a Staff-level product engineer. You'll work where strategic customer urgency, complex technical ambiguity, and GitLab product execution intersect. You'll partner directly with strategic customers and teams across Product, Engineering, Support, Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), Solutions Architecture (SA), Customer Success Architecture (CSA), Customer Success Management (CSM), and Professional Services. You'll diagnose and resolve high-impact adoption blockers, contribute production-quality fixes and features, and turn what you learn into repeatable patterns for GitLab and its customers. Why this role exists Strategic customers sometimes encounter challenges that are too broad, deep, urgent, or cross-functional for any single team to own from start to finish. These challenges may involve product gaps, performance degradation, scale bottlenecks, AI governance, adoption blockers, architectural constraints, Git usage patterns, continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD) complexity, application programming interface (API) automation, security requirements, or operational instability. Forward Deployed Engineering provides technical stewardship in these moments. The team doesn't simply observe, report, or escalate. You'll engage directly, diagnose the underlying technical problem, collaborate with the right teams, contribute code or technical solutions where appropriate, and transition the outcome into normal ownership once the customer is stable and the learning can be reused. What you’ll do Product contribution Contribute production-quality code to GitLab’s product and adjacent systems. Develop bug fixes, features, integrations, tooling, and performance improvements when strategic customer outcomes require direct engineering work. Work within GitLab’s product and engineering processes, including issue discovery, merge request creation, testing, review, documentation, and maintainability. Partner with Product and Engineering so customer-driven solutions support long-term product direction rather than becoming one-off customizations. Turn blockers discovered in the field into durable product improvements, reference architectures, documentation, and repeatable implementation patterns. Strategic technical stewardship Engage with strategically important customers when adoption, retention, executive confidence, or public trust is materially at risk. Diagnose complex problems across GitLab product behavior, customer architecture, Git internals, CI/CD workflows, API usage, observability, infrastructure, networking, and cloud environments. Coordinate across Product, Engineering, SRE, Support, SA, CSA, CSM, Professional Services, and customer technical teams to drive resolution from discovery through handoff. Provide recommendations grounded in data, traces, and systems analysis to improve GitLab usage, workflows, automation, and architecture. Create durable outcomes without establishing permanent dependency on Forward Deployed Engineering. AI adoption and agentic software development lifecycle Drive governed, measurable, and production-oriented adoption of GitLab Duo Agent Platform with strategic customers. Identify and resolve AI adoption blockers involving governance, usage controls, auditability, security, compliance, operating models, workflow design, and integrations. Develop customer-safe adoption patterns for the agentic software development lifecycle (SDLC), AI-assisted development, intent-based review, AI governance, and human-in-the-loop software delivery. Partner with Product, Engineering, Field, and Customer Success teams to turn AI adoption learning into reusable guidance and product improvements. Thought leadership Create technical narratives grounded in customer experience and product reality that can help shape the industry’s approach. Contribute to Well-Architected Frameworks, whitepapers, webinars, reference architectures, technical strategy memos, and adoption frameworks. Guide ideas through discovery, formulation, validation, amplification, and adoption across GitLab. Partner with SA, CSA, Product, Engineering, Marketing, Product Marketing Management, CSM, Support, and executive stakeholders to make technical thought leadership a shared company capability. What you’ll bring Staff-level experience building, operating, or improving complex production software systems. Experience contributing to large, mature product codebases with high standards for testing, maintainability, performance, and security. Strong Ruby on Rails or Go experience and the ability to contribute directly to GitLab’s product and adjacent systems. Experience with AI-assisted software development, agentic workflows, AI governance, model evaluation, context management, prompt and workflow design, or AI adoption in enterprise environments. Experience diagnosing complex system behavior across application code, data stores, infrastructure, observability, networking, APIs, and customer usage patterns. Deep knowledge of modern DevSecOps workflows, including Git, merge requests, CI/CD, security controls, compliance needs, and enterprise software delivery. Experience working with strategic customers or senior technical stakeholders in ambiguous, high-impact situations. The ability to coordinate across product, engineering, field, and customer teams without formal authority. Strong written communication and sound judgment, including the ability to create technical narratives and distinguish reusable product work from customer-specific customization. Strongly preferred qualifications Direct experience with GitLab as a platform, including GitLab.com, GitLab Dedicated, or GitLab Self-Managed. Production experience with Ruby on Rails, Go, PostgreSQL, Redis, Sidekiq, Vue, TypeScript, Kubernetes, Docker, Linux, or observability tools. Deep familiarity with Git internals, repository performance, large-scale Git usage patterns, or GitLab Runner behavior. Experience creating technical thought-leadership materials, such as whitepapers, technical talks, architecture frameworks, requests for comments, public technical writing, or internal strategy documents. A background in performance engineering, site reliability engineering, platform engineering, infrastructure engineering, or distributed systems. Experience working in open source or highly asynchronous engineering environments. Technologies and domains Directly relevant technologies and domains include: Ruby on Rails Go AI-assisted development and the agentic SDLC PostgreSQL Redis and Sidekiq Git internals GitLab CI/CD and Runner architecture Kubernetes and containers Terraform Linux, networking, observability, and performance analysis Vue and TypeScript APIs and automation DevSecOps governance, security, and compliance What this role is not This role isn't: A generic field engineering role. A proof-of-concept factory. A replacement for Solutions Architecture, Customer Success Architecture, Customer Success Management, Professional Services, Support, SRE, Product, or Engineering. A customer-specific customization function. Unbilled Professional Services. A requirements-gathering role that only escalates to Product. An AI evangelism role disconnected from product execution. Success measures Success in this role may include: Stabilizing strategic customer adoption or retention risks. Fixing product bugs or contributing features. Removing AI adoption blockers for strategic accounts. Creating reusable implementation patterns and transitioning them to long-term owners. Producing or enabling Well-Architected Frameworks, whitepapers, webinars, or technical narratives. Resolving cross-functional customer challenges without creating permanent dependency on Forward Deployed Engineering. Equipping Product, Engineering, Support, CSA, CSM, Professional Services, and SA teams with better guidance based on learning from the field. Increasing adoption and effective use of GitLab capabilities, especially GitLab Duo and GitLab Duo Agent Platform, in targeted accounts. About the team The Forward Deployed Engineering team connects strategic customer needs with GitLab product execution. The team works directly with customers and across GitLab to resolve complex adoption challenges, contribute durable product improvements, and create reusable technical guidance. Its goal is to stabilize urgent situations, improve the product, and transition ongoing ownership to the appropriate team rather than create a permanent dependency. Ideal candidate profile You're a Staff-level product or platform engineer who can operate in the field without becoming field-only. You're comfortable reading traces, writing production code, debugging architecture, discussing AI governance, leading a customer technical session, opening a merge request, outlining a whitepaper, and coordinating across teams to achieve a strategic customer outcome. You're not simply a strong communicator with technical awareness. You're a credible engineer with the judgment, presence, and narrative ability to turn customer reality into product contributions, adoption guidance, and company-level thought leadership. We welcome candidates with different backgrounds and levels of experience. Many successful candidates don't meet every qualification. If you're excited about this role, we encourage you to apply and let our recruiting team assess your application. How GitLab Supports Full-Time Employees Benefits to support your health, finances, and well-being Flexible Paid Time Off Team Member Resource Groups Equity Compensation & Employee Stock Purchase Plan Growth and Development Fund Parental Leave Please note that we welcome interest from candidates with varying levels of experience; many successful candidates do not meet every single requirement. Additionally, studies have shown that people from underrepresented groups are less likely to apply to a job unless they meet every single qualification. If you're excited about this role, please apply and allow our recruiters to assess your application. Country Hiring Guidelines: GitLab hires new team members in countries around the world. All of our roles are remote, however some roles may carry specific location-based eligibility requirements. Our Talent Acquisition team can help answer any questions about location after starting the recruiting process. Privacy Policy: Please review our Recruitment Privacy Policy. Your privacy is important to us. GitLab is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. GitLab’s policies and practices relating to recruitment, employment, career development and advancement, promotion, and retirement are based solely on merit, regardless of race, color, religion, ancestry, sex (including pregnancy, lactation, sexual orientation, gender identity, or gender expression), national origin, age, citizenship, marital status, mental or physical disability, genetic information (including family medical history), discharge status from the military, protected veteran status (which includes disabled veterans, recently separated veterans, active duty wartime or campaign badge veterans, and Armed Forces service medal veterans), or any other basis protected by law. GitLab will not tolerate discrimination or harassment based on any of these characteristics. See also GitLab’s EEO Policy and EEO is the Law . If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation , please let us know during the recruiting process .

Strategic technical stewardship

  • Engage with strategically important customers when adoption, retention, executive confidence, or public trust is materially at risk.

  • Create durable outcomes without establishing permanent dependency on Forward Deployed Engineering.

AI adoption and agentic software development lifecycle

  • Drive governed, measurable, and production-oriented adoption of GitLab Duo Agent Platform with strategic customers.
  • Identify and resolve AI adoption blockers involving governance, usage controls, auditability, security, compliance, operating models, workflow design, and integrations.

  • Partner with Product, Engineering, Field, and Customer Success teams to turn AI adoption learning into reusable guidance and product improvements.

Thought leadership

  • Create technical narratives grounded in customer experience and product reality that can help shape the industry’s approach.

  • Partner with SA, CSA, Product, Engineering, Marketing, Product Marketing Management, CSM, Support, and executive stakeholders to make technical thought leadership a shared company capability.

What you’ll bring

  • Staff-level experience building, operating, or improving complex production software systems.
  • Experience contributing to large, mature product codebases with high standards for testing, maintainability, performance, and security.
  • Strong Ruby on Rails or Go experience and the ability to contribute directly to GitLab’s product and adjacent systems.
  • Experience with AI-assisted software development, agentic workflows, AI governance, model evaluation, context management, prompt and workflow design, or AI adoption in enterprise environments.

  • Experience working in open source or highly asynchronous engineering environments.

Technologies and domains

Directly relevant technologies and domains include:

  • Ruby on Rails
  • Go
  • AI-assisted development and the agentic SDLC
  • PostgreSQL
  • Redis and Sidekiq
  • Git internals
  • GitLab CI/CD and Runner architecture
  • Kubernetes and containers
  • Terraform
  • Linux, networking, observability, and performance analysis
  • Vue and TypeScript
  • APIs and automation

The Forward Deployed Engineering team connects strategic customer needs with GitLab product execution. The team works directly with customers and across GitLab to resolve complex adoption challenges, contribute durable product improvements, and create reusable technical guidance. Its goal is to stabilize urgent situations, improve the product, and transition ongoing ownership to the appropriate team rather than create a permanent dependency.

title: Freelance Software Tester | Remote in Belgium
description: Hi there! We're Testlio , a global software testing company that has been helping businesses improve their digital products since 2012. We work with companies around the world to test websites, mobile apps, and online payment systems. Our freelance community helps identify issues and make sure these products work as expected for real customers. Learn more about us at www.testlio.com . About This Opportunity We're looking for people in Italy, Belgium, and Germany to help us test how local payment methods work when paying for advertising on Facebook and Instagram through Meta Ads Manager. Requirements: Location & Payment Method: Italy: Satispay account. Belgium: Wero activated with a Belgian bank account. Germany: Wero activated with a German bank account. Have access to Meta Ads Manager, or be willing to create an account. Have an iOS/Android device or a computer with an updated browser, plus a smartphone with the required payment app. Comfortable following instructions and submitting feedback in English. Available to start ASAP and complete testing by November 16, 2026. Duration: Approximately 1.5 hours. Compensation: Paid hourly testing assignment. Don't have Satispay or Wero yet? Complete a small advertising payment of approximately €5. Check whether the payment goes through successfully. Report any errors or unexpected behavior, including screenshots when needed. Why do we need local testers? Online payment methods can work differently depending on the country, bank, and device. That's why companies need local people to help check that payments are processed correctly. Your role is to follow simple instructions, complete a small authorized transaction, and tell us whether everything worked as expected. No previous software testing experience is required! Official recruitment emails will come from a @testlio.com email address, so please keep an eye on your inbox! #LI-REMOTE

title: AI/ML Researcher
description: Über YLAB Wir bauen die KI, die wir unseren eigenen Kindern geben würden. Kinder wachsen heute mit KI auf. Wir sorgen dafür, dass diese KI neugierig macht statt süchtig, sicher ist statt datenhungrig und für Kinder gebaut wird statt für Erwachsene. Wir sind YLAB, ein kleines KI-Lab aus Köln-Ehrenfeld. Wir entwickeln Software und Hardware aus einer Hand, vom Sprachmodell bis zum Gehäuse. Unser erstes Produkt ist Onoo, ein Lernbegleiter ohne Bildschirm für Kinder ab vier. Onoo fragt zurück, lässt raten und denkt mit. Er hat keine Kamera und kein Display, zeigt keine Werbung und verkauft keine Daten. Warum YLAB Deine Arbeit landet im Kinderzimmer, nicht in einem Dashboard. Software & Hardware: KI, App, Firmware und Gerät entstehen bei uns zusammen. Du siehst, wie aus Code etwas wird, das ein Kind in die Hand nimmt. Du arbeitest an echten offenen Fragen, zum Beispiel wie KI Kinderstimmen versteht und Fünfjährigen die Welt erklärt. Tech, Pädagogik und Forschung sitzen bei uns an einem Tisch. Ehrlichkeit statt Hochglanz: Vieles bauen wir zum ersten Mal. Wenn dich das reizt, sollten wir reden. Was wir bieten Verantwortung ab Tag eins: Du bekommst echte Themen und Probleme statt Tickets, und deine Entscheidungen haben Gewicht. Top Arbeitsmaterial: Du arbeitest mit dem Setup und den Tools, die du brauchst. Flexible Weiterbildung: Konferenz, Kurs oder Workshop – du sagst uns, was dich weiterbringt. Hybrid mit Herz: Remote, wenn du Ruhe brauchst, und im Office, wenn wir gemeinsam tüfteln. Über die Rolle Wie versteht ein Sprachmodell eine Vierjährige? Und wie erklärt es ihr die Welt, ohne sie zu überfordern? Dazu gibt es kaum Paper und keine Benchmarks. Genau da setzt du an. Du bist unsere erste dedizierte Research-Stelle. Du arbeitest an der Schnittstelle von KI, Sprache und Pädagogik, mit echten Familien statt Laborbedingungen und mit direktem Draht ins Produkt. Was dich erwartet: offene Fragen mit Substanz, ein Fachbeirat aus Bildung und Psychologie und die Freiheit, Studien so zu bauen, wie sie sein müssen. Wie du uns helfen kannst Du entwirfst und machst Studien mit Kindern und Familien. Von der Beobachtung im Wohnzimmer bis zum strukturierten Test. Du baust Methoden, um altersgerechte Antworten zu bewerten: Was heißt verständlich, was heißt zu viel? Du übersetzt Erkenntnisse in Modell- und Produktentscheidungen, zusammen mit Engineering und Pädagogik. Du behältst die Forschung im Blick (Child-Computer Interaction, Speech, LLM-Evals) und holst rein, was uns weiterbringt. Du teilst, was wir lernen. Wir forschen nicht für die Schublade. Melde dich, wenn: Du hast einen Research-Hintergrund, etwa HCI, Psychologie, Linguistik oder ML. Du hast schon mit Nutzer:innen geforscht, am besten mit Kindern. Du kannst beides: Interviews auswerten und saubere Metriken bauen. Du schreibst klar. Für Paper genauso wie für Produktentscheidungen. Du magst es, wenn deine Forschung nächste Woche im Prototyp steckt. Eher nicht, wenn: du Forschung als Selbstzweck siehst oder zwei Jahre Vorlauf brauchst, bevor etwas testbar ist. title: Software Engineer, Systems Architecture
description: Valinor is a new type of defense and government tech company focused on solving the problems others don't. Our unique model of centralized go-to-market and decentralized engineering allows us to move with unparalleled efficiency to identify unmet needs, build right-sized solutions, and get products where they matter most - in the hands of users. Unlike others in the space, who focus on the flashy problems, Valinor exists to solve the quiet, unaddressed problems-the small but significant ones that lead to cracks in the country's strength, stability, and security. Backed by General Catalyst, Founders Fund, and Friends & Family Capital, Valinor was founded in 2024 and has established strategic partnerships with Palantir, Anduril, and Helsing. We are building the dream team, and we want you on it. About The Role We're looking for a software engineer to own the architecture, data handling, and product layer of the software stack at one of Valinor’s product companies, currently in stealth. The system turns raw sensor data into a usable, trusted picture for the end user. You'll work directly with the General Manager and alongside a small team of engineers to rapidly develop a new product. You’ll also partner with product enablement at the Valinor Hub to stand up infrastructure and management. We see this as a step-up role: someone who has already been part of building a system like this, whether embedded/edge software, sensor or data pipelines, or detection and classification work, as a strong contributor, and is ready to own that kind of architecture for the first time, with direct partnership from the GM on the highest-stakes tradeoffs. What You'll Do 1. Overall Software Architecture Design the software architecture that ties the products data flow, processing, and user-facing product together end to end. Define clean interfaces with the sensor integration and API work, so the pieces fit into a coherent whole rather than a collection of one-offs. Make and document the core architecture decisions early, since the system needs to flex as we learn what the product needs to become. 2. Data Handling & Pipeline Architect the edge vs. cloud processing split — what runs on-system under power/compute constraints versus what gets backhauled. Stand up time-series and object storage systems for sensor and telemetry data, and the ingestion pipeline that gets data from the system to backend reliable. Design for bandwidth-constrained, compression-aware data transport, and build in the data versioning and observability needed to trust what's flowing in as sensor types multiply. 3. Detection, Classification & Pattern-of-life Work with various sensor modalities, including acoustic, EO/IR, radar, RF/AIS, and others, to build detection and classification capability — starting with classical signal-processing methods where appropriate, and applied ML where it earns its complexity. Contribute to pattern-of-life anomaly detection work. Fuse multi-modal signals into a single detection/classification output. 4. User Interface — Configuration & Visualization Build the product configuration interface and the geospatial data visualization layer (the common operating picture) the end customer will actually use. What We're Looking For Required Architecture contribution, ready to lead: you've been part of a small team that designed and built a system with real architectural stakes — edge/embedded software, sensor or data pipelines, or similar — and you're ready to own that kind of system yourself for the first time. Data pipeline and storage experience: comfortable designing and operating time-series data systems and message-based ingestion pipelines (MQTT, Kafka, or equivalent), including handling for intermittent/unreliable connectivity. Full-stack range: comfortable moving between backend/data pipeline work (Python, Go, or similar) and frontend (React/TypeScript) without needing a specialist for each; enough familiarity with embedded/edge constraints to architect around them, even if you're not writing firmware yourself. At least one sensing/signal domain: hands-on experience with at least one of acoustic, EO/IR, or radar signal processing or detection — and genuine excitement to pick up the others as the product grows into them. Cloud infrastructure ownership: able to stand up and maintain CI/CD and cloud infrastructure (AWS preferred; GovCloud experience a plus) without a dedicated DevOps function yet in place. Step-up temperament: proven ability to build and rebuild quickly with loose specs, and comfort taking ownership of a decision you'd previously have brought to someone else. Strongly Preferred TAK (or similar government system) integration experience: hands-on work integrating with TAK (ATAK/WinTAK/TAK Server) or a comparable government C2/situational-awareness system is a significant plus. Applied ML experience, particularly anomaly detection or pattern-of-life modeling. Prior experience in defense or dual-use tech, including familiarity with the general shape of DoD software requirements (security, data handling, eventual ATO/RMF processes). Geospatial visualization experience (Mapbox, Cesium, deck.gl , or similar). Prior experience on an autonomous systems, robotics, or maritime/subsea platform. What Valinor Offers Competitive salary, equity packages, and benefits, including health, dental, and vision insurance - fully covered for employees, 401K, development stipends, among others. Unlimited PTO and two-week company holiday at the end of every calendar year. We are a pro-mental health and pro-family company - we actually encourage employees to spend time with themselves and their families. Valinor also provides fertility benefits to those just beginning that journey. Fun work environment - we like to laugh and take care of each other, but we also deeply respect the mission in front of us. This role requires the candidate be eligible to obtain and maintain a U.S. security clearance. Active clearance preferred, but not required. Valinor is an equal-opportunity employer committed to creating a diverse and inclusive workplace. The Valinor team is made up of incredibly talented and unique individuals, who together are disrupting industry norms by creating new paths towards the future of defense and government technology. All qualified applicants will be treated with respect and receive equal consideration for employment without regard to race, color, creed, religion, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, uniform service, Veteran status, age, or any other protected characteristic per federal, state, or local law, including those with a criminal history, in a manner consistent with the requirements of applicable state and local laws, including the CA Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance. We actively encourage members of recognized minorities, women, Veterans, and those with disabilities to apply, and we work to create a welcoming and supportive environment for all applicants throughout the interview process. If you are someone passionate about working on problems that have a real-world impact, we'd love to hear from you!

title: Founder Associate
description: Über YLAB Wir bauen die KI, die wir unseren eigenen Kindern geben würden. Kinder wachsen heute mit KI auf. Wir sorgen dafür, dass diese KI neugierig macht statt süchtig, sicher ist statt datenhungrig und für Kinder gebaut wird statt für Erwachsene. Wir sind YLAB, ein kleines KI-Lab aus Köln-Ehrenfeld. Wir entwickeln Software und Hardware aus einer Hand, vom Sprachmodell bis zum Gehäuse. Unser erstes Produkt ist Onoo, ein Lernbegleiter ohne Bildschirm für Kinder ab vier. Onoo fragt zurück, lässt raten und denkt mit. Er hat keine Kamera und kein Display, zeigt keine Werbung und verkauft keine Daten. Warum YLAB Deine Arbeit landet im Kinderzimmer, nicht in einem Dashboard. Software & Hardware: KI, App, Firmware und Gerät entstehen bei uns zusammen. Du siehst, wie aus Code etwas wird, das ein Kind in die Hand nimmt. Du arbeitest an echten offenen Fragen, zum Beispiel wie KI Kinderstimmen versteht und Fünfjährigen die Welt erklärt. Tech, Pädagogik und Forschung sitzen bei uns an einem Tisch. Ehrlichkeit statt Hochglanz: Vieles bauen wir zum ersten Mal. Wenn dich das reizt, sollten wir reden. Was wir bieten Verantwortung ab Tag eins: Du bekommst echte Themen und Probleme statt Tickets, und deine Entscheidungen haben Gewicht. Top Arbeitsmaterial: Du arbeitest mit dem Setup und den Tools, die du brauchst. Flexible Weiterbildung: Konferenz, Kurs oder Workshop – du sagst uns, was dich weiterbringt. Hybrid mit Herz: Remote, wenn du Ruhe brauchst, und im Office, wenn wir gemeinsam tüfteln. Über die Rolle Du arbeitest direkt mit den Gründern, näher dran geht nicht. Founder Associate heißt bei uns: Du bist die Feuerwehr. Wo es brennt, bist du zuerst da, egal ob Investor-Update, Prototypen-Logistik oder der Messestand am Freitag. Dafür bekommst du den ehrlichsten Crashkurs in Company Building, den wir kennen: Du sitzt in den Entscheidungen, nicht im CC. Was du hier in einem Jahr siehst, sehen andere in fünf. Geht in Vollzeit oder als Werkstudent:in. Uns ist egal, was auf deinem Vertrag steht, solange du Verantwortung willst. Wie du uns helfen kannst Du räumst weg, was die Gründer bremst: Recherchen, Entscheidungsvorlagen, Angebote, Ämterpost, Orga. Du springst dahin, wo es gerade brennt, von Operations über Events bis zum Support für unsere Testfamilien. Du bereitest Entscheidungen vor: Zahlen ziehen, Optionen sortieren, klare Empfehlung dazuschreiben. Du baust kleine Prozesse und Tools, damit dasselbe Feuer nicht zweimal ausbricht. Du hältst die Fäden zu Partnern und Lieferanten zusammen, wenn es schnell gehen muss. Melde dich, wenn: Du willst in einem Jahr mehr lernen als andere in fünf. Du erledigst Dinge, bevor jemand fragt, ob sie schon erledigt sind. Chaos macht dich nicht nervös. Du machst Listen draus. Du schreibst klar und schnell, auf Deutsch und auf Englisch. Du bist Generalist:in aus Überzeugung und lernst Neues schneller, als Stellenprofile es erlauben. Du studierst noch oder bist gerade fertig? Passt. Erfahrung schlägt Etikett. Eher nicht, wenn: du eine Jobbeschreibung brauchst, die stimmt. Deine ändert sich hier jede Woche. Oder wenn du Feuer lieber meldest, als es zu löschen. Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Backend Engineer, Buyer
description:
Brief info about Vinted 

Our mission is to make second-hand the first choice, and we're looking for people who want to help us get there. Every day, we work together to help our members buy and sell pre-loved clothing and lifestyle items, giving each piece a second life – or even a third.
The Vinted Group is made up of three business units that support this mission:

Vinted Marketplace is Europe’s leading platform for second-hand fashion and a go-to destination for all kinds of pre-loved items, with a growing range of categories. Our platform connects millions of members across 20+ markets, helping great items find a new life.

Vinted Go enhances the shipping experience with a vast network of over 500,000 pick-up and drop-off points, partnering with more than 60 carriers across Europe, with added services like item verification for peace of mind on high-value pieces.

Vinted Pay is the newest part of the Vinted Group, dedicated to bringing secure, reliable payments to buyers and sellers across Europe. Seamlessly integrated into the Vinted app, it helps keep every transaction safe, efficient, and easy for our members.

Founded in 2008 in Lithuania, Vinted began as a way for friends to find new homes for clothes they no longer needed. In 2019, we became Lithuania's first unicorn! Today, our headquarters remain in Vilnius, and we've grown with offices across Europe, supported by a team of over 2,000 people. 

Information about the position 

The Buyer Domain at Vinted is dedicated to creating a seamless and highly engaging experience for our members as they search, discover, and purchase items. Our challenge is unique: unlike standard e-commerce, our peer-to-peer catalogue consists of hundreds of millions of entirely unique, single-inventory listings, with millions of new items uploaded daily. Connecting the right buyer with the perfect item in real-time is at the very core of Vinted's success.

The CVP team owns the core platform and services that govern how content is geofenced, balanced, and surfaced across Vinted's growing international network of markets. We build robust systems and tooling that manage cross-border visibility, enabling smooth and gradual market connections (e.g., FR-DE, BE-FR-ES) while optimising key liquidity metrics like Sell-Through Rate (STR%) and Gross Merchandise Value (GMV) by balancing the content in multiple channels.

Our team works closely with Content Visibility Management, Search, and Recommender relevance teams to accelerate product development. Currently, we are driving the automation of content visibility experimentation & analysis. Rather than having different content channels independently re-implement visibility controls, we are building a unified platform to provide autonomy to Decision Scientists. In addition, we are highly contributing in growing new large markets such as the USA and Australia.

In this position, you’ll 

  • Drive technical execution: Design, implement, and maintain highly scalable, reliable, and secure backend systems to ensure efficient content visibility and search mechanisms.
  • Guide technical decisions: Contribute to and challenge the technical direction of our backend services, leading system design reviews and ensuring high-quality, maintainable code.
  • Scale features globally: Implement and shape A/B tested features that positively impact our 80+ million users. Code changes are rolled out instantly to production.
  • Own your services: Monitor and improve backend service performance and stability. The team owns and monitors service-layer measurements (SLIs, SLOs, etc.) and has an on-call rotation which you will participate in.
  • Lead team-level initiatives: Lead and drive technical initiatives within the team, while collaborating on domain-wide integrations with other engineering teams (such as Search and Recommender relevance teams).
  • Collaborate cross-functionally: Work closely with engineering and product managers, analysts, and other stakeholders, facilitating clear communication within the team and across domains.
  • Contribute to product direction: Provide technical feasibility assessments, identify technical risks, and provide effort estimations to help shape our team's product roadmap.
  • Foster engineering excellence: Mentor, guide, and share knowledge with other engineers in the team to support their technical growth and promote collaborative best practices

About you 

  • You have extensive experience in backend software engineering, with a proven track record of designing and building scalable, distributed, and highly available systems.
  • You are highly proficient in backend development. We primarily use Go, Kotlin, Ruby, Python — while prior experience in these specific languages is beneficial, a strong foundation in modern backend engineering and a willingness to learn is what matters most.
  • Experience with event streaming platforms like Kafka, Apache Flink, or others for real-time data processing and message queueing.
  • A track record working with search engines, information retrieval and ranking optimisations technologies (e.g., Vespa, Elasticsearch, OpenSearch) is a high advantage. If not, we expect you to have a strong willingness and motivation to learn.
  • You are enthusiastic about AI technologies, use AI tools daily in your work, and proactively learn and experiment with how to adopt AI to boost engineering outcomes.
  • Strong understanding of continuous integration and deployment pipelines, with experience in tools like Jenkins for automating builds and deployments.
  • Experience with observability and monitoring tools (we use Grafana, Kibana, and others) to keep services healthy and define SLIs/SLOs.
  • Experience working with relational and in-memory databases.
  • Strong collaboration and communication skills, with experience working with cross-functional peers (Product, Analytics, SRE).
  • Experience in mentoring other engineers, providing constructive feedback, and promoting engineering best practices within your team.
  • Excellent written and spoken English.

Work perks 

  • The opportunity to benefit from our share options programme
  • 30 days of paid annual leave
  • Newest MacBook models
  • Confidential Employee Assistance Program (EAP) for you and your family
  • Home office support: we provide IT workstation equipment and a personal budget of up to €540 for home workplace furniture
  • Lunch benefit per your workday
  • Frequent team-building events
  • A personal monthly budget for shopping on Vinted
  • Access to a discounted gym membership plan
  • Pension Plan with Vinted matching 150% of your chosen contribution
  • Supplemental Private Health Insurance
  • Life and Disability insurance
  • A subsidised Deutschlandticket for your commute to the office by public transport
  • A dog-friendly office

Working at Vinted 

Workation policy 

Better balance holidays with workdays by working remotely! Up to 90 days per year in the EU, of these, 21 days can be spent globally. For non-EU citizens, it's 21 days worldwide. This can be combined with time off for vacation or personal time.

Individual learning budget

Each year, you’ll be given a learning budget (starting at €3,000), and a total of up to 10 working days over a 2-year period to support your personal and professional development.

Hybrid work 

Our hybrid model, with 2 recommended office days a week, gives you and your team the flexibility to decide if and when you want to work from home, and when to catch up in person.

Equal opportunity

We welcome applications from everybody, regardless of your background, identity, or life experiences. Job openings come with guides, not checklists. If you’re excited about a role, but don’t identify with every point in the ‘About you’ section, apply anyway – you might still be the perfect match!

€87.600—€118.500 EUR

title: Senior Software Engineer, Roku UI
description:
Teamwork makes the stream work.

 

Roku is changing how the world watches TV

Roku is the #1 TV streaming platform in the U.S., Canada, and Mexico, and we've set our sights on powering every television in the world. Roku pioneered streaming to the TV. Our mission is to be the TV streaming platform that connects the entire TV ecosystem. We connect consumers to the content they love, enable content publishers to build and monetize large audiences, and provide advertisers unique capabilities to engage consumers.

From your first day at Roku, you'll make a valuable - and valued - contribution. We're a fast-growing public company where no one is a bystander. We offer you the opportunity to delight millions of TV streamers around the world while gaining meaningful experience across a variety of disciplines.

 

 

About the team

At Roku, the UI Systems team builds the high-performance engines and core graphics infrastructure that power millions of devices. We own the low-level C++ frameworks, rendering pipelines, and system architectures that enable smooth navigation and rich animations. Our work sits at the intersection of hardware and software, where we optimize graphics rendering, memory management, and layout engines to ensure a consistent, lightning-fast experience across our entire device portfolio. We operate in a collaborative, high-trust environment, partnering closely with firmware and silicon teams to push the boundaries of what’s possible on embedded hardware.

About the role

As a Senior Software Engineer, you will be a key architect of the core systems that underpin Roku’s user experience. You will design and implement performance-critical code within our UI engine, focusing on graphics primitives, memory efficiency, and hardware acceleration. You’ll tackle complex systems-level challenges—such as optimizing frame rates on resource-constrained hardware and building robust APIs for higher-level frameworks. This role is ideal for engineers who thrive on low-level systems programming, care about performance down to the microsecond, and want to build the high-performance foundations that power the future of television.

What you’ll be doing

  • Architect and optimize core C++ UI frameworks and rendering engines to ensure buttery-smooth performance across a diverse range of hardware profiles.
  • Lead technical investigations into system-level bottlenecks, memory leaks, and GPU/CPU synchronization issues.
  • Develop and maintain low-level graphics APIs and layout systems that serve as the backbone for Roku’s application ecosystem.
  • Integrate AI/ML capabilities at the systems level, leveraging generative AI tools to optimize code generation and automate performance profiling.
  • Collaborate with firmware and driver teams to leverage hardware-specific optimizations and ensure seamless integration with the underlying OS.
  • Mentor junior developers through deep-dive code reviews, architectural design sessions, and technical documentation of core systems.
  • Drive engineering excellence by implementing advanced debugging tools, automated performance regression suites, and modern C++ best practices.

We’re excited if you have

  • Minimum of 5+ years of software engineering experience with a heavy focus on C++ (C++14/17/20).
  • Deep understanding of systems programming, including memory management, multi-threading, and hardware-software abstraction layers.
  • Experience with graphics APIs (e.g., OpenGL, Vulkan, or proprietary embedded graphics stacks) and rendering pipelines.
  • Proficiency in Python for tooling and automation, with a working knowledge of BrightScript or JavaScript being a significant plus.
  • Strong root cause analysis skills, specifically using tools like GDB, Valgrind, or platform-specific profilers.
  • Knowledge of AI applications and hands-on experience using generative AI tools to accelerate systems-level development.
  • A proactive mindset with a passion for squeezing every drop of performance out of embedded systems and a commitment to data-driven optimization.
