About the Role

The Product Marketing Manager will own how Nabla positions, launches, and drives adoption of the product with clinicians across their entire journey — from onboarding and activation through engagement and retention.

This is product marketing where the message ships directly to the user. You own the narrative for every new feature launch, then own the in-app and email programs that turn that narrative into activation.

You'll define the segmentation, write the positioning, ship the campaigns, and measure whether they actually moved adoption.

Userpilot is in place, but everything around it still needs to be built: the activation and adoption strategy, in-app and email templates, segmentation, cohort analysis, the process with Product Marketing peers, CSM, PM, and Design, and the campaign calendar.

This is a hands-on, highly operational PMM role. We need someone who lives in the tools, is data-driven, can test fast, structure the process, and turn usage insights into concrete positioning and messaging decisions.

Userpilot is the first step. Over time, this person will take ownership of the full communication stack across email, in-app, and other channels. The role works extremely closely with Product Marketing peers, Design, PM, Data, and Product Ops.

Nabla serves two distinct audiences, and lifecycle programs must work for both:

  • Self-serve clinicians, who discover, activate, and adopt the product largely on their own. Here, automated email and in-app communication carries most of the relationship — your messaging is the go-to-market motion.

  • Mid-market and enterprise health systems, managed by CSMs. Here the human relationship leads, and your programs must arm and reinforce the CSM — giving them timing, context, and content, never working around them.

You'll design each lifecycle so the right channel leads for each segment. On top of this, healthtech is a highly regulated industry with demanding clients: every communication must meet a high bar for accuracy, security, and professionalism, while still feeling personal and useful to busy clinicians.

Responsibilities

Feature Launch Positioning & Activation

  • Own weekly in-app launch communication for new features, end to end and at a fast cadence

  • Define the positioning and messaging for each release — what it is, why a clinician should care, what changes in their day

  • Design the in-app experience (placement, format, flow) for each launch

  • Validate messaging with Product Marketing peers, PM, and Design before shipping

  • Launch on time and coordinate across the relevant teams

  • Track performance (reach, engagement, adoption) for every launch and iterate quickly on results

  • Stay highly reactive to the product roadmap, turning new releases into clear, well-timed clinician communication

Lifecycle Strategy and Execution

  • Own the full lifecycle strategy across onboarding, activation, engagement, and retention, ensuring each stage of the practitioner journey is intentional, personalized, and measurable

  • Tailor segmentation, messaging, and cadence to the distinct needs of each segment:

    • For self-serve, build automated email and in-app programs that drive activation, adoption, and retention with minimal human touch

    • For mid-market and enterprise, build programs that complement and support CSMs

  • Direct and execute creative strategy for lifecycle channels — briefing, reviewing, and optimizing copy and design for brand consistency and message effectiveness

  • Build and maintain a clear campaign calendar across functions

Experimentation and Analytics

  • Lead a rigorous experimentation roadmap: A/B and multivariate testing of messaging, creative, cadence, segmentation, and value propositions

  • Define and own lifecycle KPIs, building reporting frameworks and sharing regular performance insights with marketing and cross-functional leadership

  • Partner with Data and Analytics on audience segmentation, behavioral signals, and AI-driven insights to enhance personalization at scale

  • Turn cohort and usage insights into concrete messaging and product-marketing actions

Cross-functional Collaboration

  • Collaborate with Product Marketing peers, Design, PM, Data, Product Ops, Clinical, and Brand to align lifecycle programs with broader business goals and the practitioner experience

  • Establish a clear, repeatable process across Product Marketing, CSM, PM, and Design for planning and shipping campaigns

  • Ensure all programs are developed and executed in compliance with HIPAA and applicable federal and state laws, partnering with Legal and Compliance as needed

Operations and Tooling

  • Take ownership of the full communication stack, starting with Userpilot

  • Evaluate and manage lifecycle marketing technology partnerships, recommending optimizations as we scale

  • Build and maintain process documentation, campaign playbooks, and training materials on internal platforms

  • Leverage AI tools as a core part of daily work (drafting, research, iteration) to improve efficiency, quality, and decision-making

What We Are Looking For

  • 3-5 years in B2B product marketing, lifecycle marketing, or product-led growth marketing, including hands-on ownership of in-app channels

  • Proven ability to craft positioning and messaging for product launches and to ship it yourself, not hand it off

  • Deep expertise across the full post-signup funnel (onboarding, activation, engagement, retention)

  • Strong Product DNA, with sharp attention to user workflows and the details that shape the product experience

  • Strong strategic and analytical thinking, with the ability to translate complex data into clear hypotheses, actionable insights, and business recommendations

raw.description:
About the Role

The Destinus Industralization team is seeking an Industralization Engineer to help brining products from R&D to full scale production. The role requires expertise in balancing process and product optimization throughout the development cycle of the project as well as sound and realistic assessment where the improvements will bring the most impact in the given timeline.

The ideal candidate takes ownership of their work, leads by example and understands that approach to industrialization should be agile to fit best the fast-paced projects.

What You'll Do

• Enable R&D team to implement DFX from the beginning of the project.

• Review and optimise existing and new processes of assembly and manufacturing to assure repeatable quality of products.

• Find and audit suitable suppliers and manufacturers.

• Set up suppliers and manufacturers as partners.

• Establish and maintain communication with suppliers to enable manufacturing R&D, Batch Zero and Full Scale Production quantities.

• Be a link between R&D, production and qualification department, with thorough understanding how design choices impact assembly line.

• Perform material flow and value chain analysis

• Design assembly lines which comply to safety and quality requirements to assure repeatable processes and quality of the final product.

• Assemble prototypes and assure the product maturity necessary to pass review gates

• Write, maintain, and follow SOPs for assembly, integration, and testing operations, ensuring safety and repeatability at every step.

• Support troubleshooting and corrective actions in collaboration with engineering and QA teams.

• Contribute to continuous improvement of assembly workflows while maintaining compliance with safety and quality requirements.

Requirements

What You'll Need

• Several years of industrialization experience with maintaining full R&D to Production workflow

• Excellent hands-on engineering

• Experience with various manufacturing methods; milling, turning, plastic injection moulding, casting, 3D printing.

• Experience or willingness to work with energetic, pyrotechnic, or otherwise hazardous materials; knowledge of relevant safety requirements is a strong advantage.

• Experience with quality control, functional testing, and documentation standards in a production or engineering environment.

• Ability to write and execute SOPs in a detail-driven, safety-critical environment.

• High attention to detail and a disciplined, methodical approach to assembly and testing.

• Willingness to travel when setting up a suppliers and manufacturers

• Fluency in English and German required; any other language is a plus.

  • You’ll join a structured onboarding program designed to help you ramp up smoothly. During this period, you will:
  • Meet your buddy and team, and get to know Fever’s culture and ways of working.
  • Set up your local environment and become familiar with our Python-based stack, CI/CD pipelines, and cloud infrastructure.
  • Learn about our architecture and observability tools while contributing small improvements and fixes.
  • Have your first code running in production and a clear understanding of our delivery flow and processes.
  • By the end of the onboarding, you’ll be ready to join your long-term squad and start contributing to larger initiatives.

After 3 months at Fever:

  • You’ll be confidently collaborating and delivering at full speed. You will:
  • Design and implement end-to-end features within your squad.
  • Participate in architectural discussions and propose improvements across our services and APIs.
  • Work with event-driven systems and focus on performance, reliability, and scalability.
  • Collaborate closely with Product, Data, and other Engineering teams to enhance our platform and developer experience.

By your 6th month at Fever:

  • You’ll be fully established as a key contributor in your team. You will:
  • Take ownership of core components and help evolve their architecture.
  • Lead by example through code reviews, design sessions, and mentoring.
  • Contribute to best practices in areas like scalability, observability, and system design.
  • Drive continuous improvement and have a visible impact on how we build high-performing services at scale.
  • Become an expert in your domain, using business context and technical excellence to drive strategic initiatives forward

About you

Must have skills:

  • Strong knowledge of best practices, testing, and design patterns
  • You are proficient in business English
  • You know how to deliver code from development to production
  • Experience with RESTful APIs (implementation and consumption)
  • Knowledge of relational databases and SQL
  • Experience with event streaming platforms such as Kafka or RabbitMQ
  • Handling services with high concurrencies and high volume requests.

We use these technologies, so it would be a plus if you have experience in:

  • Django/Flask
  • PostgreSQL and Redis
  • AWS, Docker, and Kubernetes

Benefits & Perks

  • 23 days of vacation plus half a day on your birthday
  • Private medical insurance sponsored by the company
  • 40% discount on Fever Marketplace
  • Flexibility to work from home
  • English & Spanish conversational classes
  • Wellhub (former Gympass) membership
  • Possibility to receive part of your salary in advance with Payflow
  • Flexible remuneration with Cobee
  • Budget for engineering events and trainings
  • Young and international environment
  • Attractive compensation package consisting of base salary and the potential to earn a significant bonus for top performance.
    • Base Salary: 50K - 75K EUR
    • Total Compensation: 67K - 90K EUR (Including Base, Variable, and Stock Options)

raw.jobDescription:
About Neuroscale

Neuroscale is on a mission to fill the world’s most important roles.

Recruiting is a zero-sum game. The best people get hired once, and the teams that move fastest win. We build Arbi, an AI recruiting platform that combines autonomous agents with elite recruiters so world-class companies and federal agencies can hire well and grow fast.

Arbi searches 800M+ profiles, runs outreach, and interviews candidates at scale. Through every search, placement, and interaction on our platform, we capture proprietary hiring data that no one else has at scale, and that data powers the agentic systems we are building to make hiring faster, smarter, and more precise.

We believe AI will create more jobs, not less. As companies move faster with fewer constraints, they will hire more ambitiously and for roles that did not exist before, making the hiring layer more critical than ever.

We hold a USAF SBIR Direct-to-Phase-II contract, sell into federal through Carahsoft, and work with enterprise, federal, and regulated organizations that most AI startups cannot touch. Our second product, Athena, extends the same agent infrastructure into federal agency workflows.

We are a small, founder-led team and this is one of the first engineering seats.

About the Role

You will work directly with the founders on the hardest technical questions in the product:

  • How do we understand the nuance in a hiring requirement well enough to find the person a filter & criteria search never would?

  • How do we interview candidates at scale and turn those conversations into a data edge no public profile can give you?

  • How do agents decide who to reach out to, what to say, and when to hand off to a human?

  • How do we make a recruiter say “wow” in the first five minutes?

You will design, build, and ship features end to end, most of them built on LLMs. Recent work includes agent execution infrastructure, feedback loops that improve search quality from recruiter behavior, and multi-tenant deployment for regulated customers.

Our stack: Next.js + React, Node.js, Python FastAPI, OpenSearch (Elasticsearch), Temporal, and a range of inference providers and models.

About You

  • You have built something from scratch. A startup, a product, a system people depend on.

  • You ship. We care more about what you have built than where you have worked.

  • You are high agency. You find the highest-leverage problem, decide it is yours, and attack it.

  • You have shown excellence somewhere: work, school, open source, a side project that took off.

  • You take asymmetric bets. Joining a founding team is one of them.

  • You have real experience with the core of our stack: Next.js, Node.js, AWS, and search or data infrastructure.

  • Experience with LLM products, voice or conversational AI, or search at scale is a plus, not a filter.

  • Based in or willing to relocate to Northern Virginia. We build in person.

Why Founding

  • Direct ownership of core systems from day one. Your decisions become the architecture.

  • Meaningful founding equity. You should share in what you build.

  • Work on problems with real stakes: federal hiring, regulated industries, roles that matter.

  • A front-row seat to going from early traction to category leader.

Compensation and Benefits

  • Competitve salary plus meaningful founding equity.

  • Comprehensive health, dental, and vision coverage.

  • Meals provided in office.

  • Relocation support for the right candidate.

Neuroscale AI is an equal opportunity employer.

title: Senior Software Developer, Search
description: MaintainX is a leading mobile-first work execution platform for industrial and frontline teams. More than 15,000 customers , including McDonalds, Michaels, Cintas, Redimix, and U.S. LBM, use MaintainX to cut unplanned downtime and run better operations, across 16 million managed assets and 92 million completed work orders. In August 2026 MaintainX became part of Autodesk, joining Autodesk Operations Solutions , the organization unifying Autodesk's operations platform alongside Tandem, FlexSim and Fusion Operations. Autodesk's strategy is to converge design, make and operate into one continuous lifecycle: design an asset, build it, run it, then feed what you learn running it back into the next design. Autodesk had design and make. Operate is the phase that tells you what actually happened, and it is ours. About the Role We’re starting a new Search team to make it easier for users find exactly what they need across MaintainX. You’ll play a critical role in designing, building, and scaling search infrastructure that reflects the unique shape of the MaintainX domain. This is a zero-to-one role. You’ll be scoping ambiguity, shipping usable search early, and evolving it with fast feedback loops. If you enjoy building systems from scratch, obsess over performance and relevance, and want your work to power daily decisions across industries, we’d love to talk. What You'll Do: Design and build MaintainX’s end-to-end search and retrieval platform — from indexing pipelines and ranking systems to AI-facing query layers. Partner with product and domain experts to model search across core entities like work orders, assets, and procedures, ensuring high-relevance results. Ship fast, iterate fast, launch early versions, gather feedback, and improve rapidly. Operate and optimize distributed systems, ensuring reliability, performance, and scalability under real-world load. Drive architectural decisions, balancing correctness, performance, and long-term maintainability. Own integrations between search systems and upstream data sources. Explore semantic search, vector retrieval, and AI-enhanced relevance using modern ML tooling. On-call duties (currently business hours) About You: Hands-on experience designing, building, and operating production-grade search systems end-to-end — including indexing, query execution, relevance tuning, and infrastructure — using technologies such as Elasticsearch, OpenSearch, Lucene, Solr, or similar. Understanding of embeddings, chunking, and retrieval strategies. Familiarity with search-specific tuning: analyzers, BM25, shard sizing, cluster health, and relevance optimization. Comfort taking systems from implementation to deployment and production operation, working across backend services, data pipelines, and integration points as needed. An expert level of English, both spoken and written, is required, as the individual will need to lead platform engineering managers across multiple teams, present technical priorities to executive stakeholders, and align with engineering leaders outside Québec on a daily basis. Nice to Have: Experience evaluating and improving search relevance using both qualitative analysis and quantitative metrics. Experience shipping AI-powered or LLM-integrated backend systems Comfortable using modern AI tools like GPT, Copilot, or Cursor to boost productivity and streamline development. Understanding of multi-tenancy and data security , including ACLs, field-level access controls, and secure index partitioning. Experience building observability and success metrics into systems to monitor performance, usage, and impact. Our mission is to keep the physical world running. Factories, fleets, hospitals and campuses stay up because the people who maintain them have tools worth using. That is what we build. Compensation and benefits. Base pay is one part of the package. Depending on the role, compensation may also include commission, an annual bonus and equity. Benefits differ by country. For roles in the United States, Autodesk’s benefits are described at benefits.autodesk.com . For roles in Canada and other countries, the plan differs on health coverage, retirement and leave, and your recruiter will walk you through it. Belonging. We take pride in a culture where everyone can thrive. More at autodesk.com/company/global-belonging . More on where this is going: Autodesk CEO Andrew Anagnost on building the future of connected operations , and AOS SVP Stephen Hooper on welcoming MaintainX to Autodesk .

raw.jobDescription:
Who We Are

Second Dinner is an award-winning independent game development studio that is here to make the most fun games in the world. Not super fun games. Not SUPER DUPER fun games. We mean the MOST fun games. In fact, our game MARVEL SNAP has earned multiple Mobile Game of the Year Awards (Game Awards, DICE), Best Strategy Game (IGN), and the Apple Design Award for Innovation!

Second Dinner is a remote-first studio, so while we are headquartered in Irvine, California, most of our team is fully remote across the United States. We want the most talented teammates wherever they call home. A diverse team with varied perspectives makes us a better company and will help us make better games. If you can bring something new to the table and expand our point of view, that's a huge upside.

Our Engineering Team:

At Second Dinner, we believe that great people in a great work environment lead to great games and player experiences. In engineering, we empower our teams to build and innovate with best-in-class tools in novel ways. Our goal is to simplify game development and redefine what is possible in game development.

Your Role:

You will own and drive Marvel Snap’s Test Automation initiative, as well as perform various DevOps duties. You will report to the Lead Engineer of the Live Stability team and collaborate with QA analysts, engineers, and artists to create test suites, build pipelines, and develop tools to ensure we deliver the highest quality games possible to our players! If you’re passionate about testing, automation, validation, and continuous integration, then we'd love to hear from you!

This is a 6-month contract role to start (with possible extension), but if it's a great mutual fit, it could evolve into a full-time position.

What You’ll Do:

  • As an automation superhero, you’ll identify, design, and deliver technical solutions (frameworks, tests, API hooks, tools) that increase test effectiveness, coverage, and overall development velocity

  • Build and enhance continuous integration and delivery pipelines to support development teams across MARVEL SNAP

  • Own the long-term development and roadmap of test automation

  • Implement metrics, analyze test data to identify patterns, and report on risk status to help enhance software quality

  • Optimize testing efforts and develop new opportunities using automation that will empower the QA team to be more effective and efficient

  • Automate everything: from command lines to complex workflows, find opportunities to improve how we build and test the game, ultimately to improve the player experience

What You’ll Need:

  • Demonstrated ability designing and owning scalable automated testing solutions, including test frameworks, test infrastructure, and execution pipelines

  • Proficiency in unit and integration test frameworks in C#/.NET or other object-oriented programming language

  • Experience integrating test pipelines into CI/CD workflows such as GitHub Actions or Jenkins

  • Knowledge of industry best testing practices, including unit, integration, end-to-end, acceptance, functional, and performance testing

  • Ability to work independently, charting the course for the company in test automation

  • Passion for empowering teams with best-in-class automated testing tools, frameworks, and test harnesses to improve operations

  • An agile mindset, a desire for constant improvement of tooling, automation, and process to improve the quality of our products and the lives of our teammates

  • High levels of empathy and support for team members, both technical and non-technical

  • Passion for playing and making great games

Nice to Have, But Not Necessary:

  • Experience with test automation in Unity, such as Unity Test Runner

description:
The role

HelloFresh manages approximately €1.7B in annual direct procurement spend across ingredients and packaging, covering markets in the EU, US, Canada, ANZ, and the UK. This role builds the cost intelligence capability for Global Procurement. You will create the analytical models and frameworks that give the business clear visibility into what ingredients really cost: where those costs come from, how they move, and where the opportunities lie. Your work will give regional teams the insight they need to make well-grounded decisions and to track progress against the group's cost reduction ambitions. This is a role for a senior procurement professional who is comfortable with detailed analysis and who can explain complex numbers simply to senior leaders and to colleagues in markets. You will be recognized as the go-to expert on cost across the team.

What you’ll do

  • Develop a harmonized cost measurement methodology with Finance and regional procurement teams, so that ingredient savings are defined, measured, and reported consistently across all markets.
  • Build should-cost models and total cost of ownership frameworks for priority categories, breaking unit price into its drivers (origin, processing method, logistics, certification, and shelf life), and use them to identify savings and inform sourcing decisions.

You are...

  • An analytical professional who builds models that hold up to scrutiny from Finance and senior leadership.

You have...

  • 5+ years in procurement, cost analysis, or consulting in a global food, retail, or consumer goods business.

title: Senior Director, International Development
description:
Thank you for considering Oklo. We are hiring a Senior Director, International Affairs to join our Strategy team.

Position Description

Oklo is seeking a Senior Director of International Affairs to develop international opportunities that can materially advance the company's long-term strategy. This role connects market choices, senior relationships, sovereign and government capital, industrial partnerships, and selected cross-border initiatives.

You will help determine where Oklo should engage, which institutions matter, and what a credible partnership or investment proposition should look like. The scope extends across the company's businesses and strategic priorities, rather than being limited to individual international reactor deployment projects.

You will report to the Chief of Strategy Officer and work directly with the CSO on assigned initiatives. You will coordinate closely with the CFO organization, Government Affairs, Legal, technical and regulatory leaders, and business-unit teams, with explicit agreement on market coverage, counterpart relationships, and execution responsibilities.

This person must reside in either the United Kingdom or the Netherlands. 

Specific responsibilities may include:

  • Target markets and partnerships. Develop recommendations on priority markets, institutions, and opportunities based on strategic fit, partner capabilities, commercial demand, capital availability, timing, and risk.
  • Sovereign and institutional relationships. Build and advance relationships with sovereign investors, government institutions, industrial partners, and other organizations relevant to Oklo's global strategy.
  • Structure international opportunities. Develop business cases and proposed structures for international partnerships, sovereign or government-capital opportunities, joint ventures, and other cross-border initiatives.
  • Advance transactions. Work with Finance, Business Development, Corporate Development, Strategic Partnerships, and Legal to test economics, assess counterparties, develop terms, and advance approved opportunities toward executable agreements.
  • Navigate regulatory and policy dependencies. Coordinate with Government Affairs and technical, regulatory, and legal specialists on political, policy, licensing, export, and other dependencies that affect an opportunity's feasibility.
  • Lead initiative execution. Lead assigned initiatives across internal teams and outside advisers, maintaining clear objectives, owners, milestones, and decisions through launch or handoff.
  • Prepare and represent leadership. Prepare senior leadership for important international engagements and represent Oklo when delegated; work with the Strategy Associate on research, analysis, and materials and the Strategy Manager on coordinated follow-through.
  • Align cross-functional stakeholders. Align engagement plans with existing international and business-unit owners, avoid conflicting commitments, and recommend where to advance, defer, or decline an opportunity.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Experience in international business, strategic investing, government, industrial partnerships, or a related field, with evidence of delivering outcomes across institutions and jurisdictions.
  • Demonstrated ability to develop substantive relationships with senior government, commercial, or financial counterparties and translate engagement into concrete opportunities
  • Strong commercial and financial judgment, including the ability to evaluate partnership economics, business cases, and potential capital structures.
  • Experience leading cross-functional work while drawing on appropriate technical, legal, policy, and financial expertise.
  • Excellent writing and cross-cultural communication, sound discretion, and the ability to make practical recommendations from incomplete information.
  • Must reside in the UK or the Netherlands.

Bonus Qualifications:

  • Experience with sovereign investors, development finance, government-backed capital, or cross-border industrial ventures.
  • Exposure to nuclear energy, the fuel cycle, infrastructure, advanced technology, or other strategically important industries.
  • Experience connecting government and commercial objectives; relevant regional expertise or additional language capabilities.

Competencies

We are looking for a Senior Director, International Affairs that is:

  • Able to connect geopolitical and institutional context to specific commercial choices
  • Able to build durable trust while maintaining clear objectives and realistic commitments
  • Able to work effectively across cultures, disciplines, and organizations with different incentives
  • Can distinguish meaningful strategic progress from access, visibility, or meeting volume
  • Passionate about clean energy 
  • Passionate about making advanced fission a reality
  • Willing and able to learn quickly
  • Highly strategic and a forward-looking thinker
  • An entrepreneurial mindset with comfort operating in ambiguity
  • An exceptional communicator, negotiator, and has relationship-building skills
  • Contains a strong executive presence and cross-functional leadership ability
  • Aware of global perspectives with awareness of geopolitical and macroeconomic trends
  • Passionate for building transformational infrastructure businesses
  • Eager to work on a dynamic team, receive constructive feedback, and grow with us
  • Willing to think differently and do things in new ways 
  • Comfortable in a fast-paced, highly iterative startup environment
  • Excited to think creatively, critically, and reflectively about the problems they are solving, while not leaning only on what has been done before 
  • Willing to propose novel and creative solutions to technical problems
  • An excellent writer who can write in modern active voice, so make your cover letter compelling and write it well!
  • Able to communicate technical content and results verbally 

Who you are:

A startup person: You aren't driven by titles or hierarchy, and prefer efficiency to excess process. You don't need or expect to have a lot of guidance but you enjoy working in a fast-paced team. If you prefer the culture and feel of a large organization, that is great, but you likely won’t enjoy working with us! There is plenty of important work and plenty of good opportunities with organizations like that.

Motivated: You are self-motivated. You bring an enthusiasm to the team, and imbue a sense of passion that goes beyond clocking in and clocking out. This isn’t about a fake or arbitrary “pieces of flair” mentality or lack of work-life balance! It is about being a part of the vision and feeling a part of reaching team goals.

A team-player: Oklo genuinely is a team. We aren’t about taking credit for ourselves, and we aren’t about pushing blame to others. We do incredible things because we work as a team.

An excellent communicator: We need a person who is not only technically competent but also a clear and upbeat communicator.

Creative: Being creative means that when things fall outside clear scopes or processes or problems arise without clear solutions, you are able to identify it as well as invent ways to solve a problem or fill a need without micromanagement. The successful person in this job will not only be creative, but also enjoy being creative and solving open-ended problems which may change day-by-day.

Detail-oriented: This focus is a big part of excellence, consistency, and quality. Excellent grammar and spelling matter for both good communication as well as the image of the company that we put forward.

 

About Oklo compensation:

Salary: $250,000-$290,000

Oklo offers flexible time off, equity, bonuses, competitive pay, 401(k), health insurance (with employer contribution), HSA, FSA, flexible work hours, wellness credits, and other benefits.

About Oklo Inc.: Oklo Inc. is developing fast fission power plants to deliver clean, reliable, and affordable energy at scale; establishing a domestic supply chain for critical radioisotopes; and advancing nuclear fuel recycling to convert nuclear waste into clean energy. Oklo was the first to receive a site use permit from the U.S. Department of Energy for a commercial advanced fission plant, was awarded fuel material from Idaho National Laboratory, and submitted the first custom combined license application for an advanced reactor to the U.S. Nuclear Regulatory Commission. Oklo is also developing advanced fuel recycling technologies in collaboration with the U.S. Department of Energy and U.S. National Laboratories.

#CHOP: Oklo’s Values
Collaboration: We go further, together. We bring diverse perspectives, listen actively, and build trust through transparency and respect. We work across disciplines, sharing ownership to turn complex challenges into shared successes.
Humility: We are team players who act for the good of the company and for the world. We are focused on our mission, not personal recognition.
Ownership: We take pride in what we do and how we do it. We are proactive in finding solutions and see tasks through  to completion. We are committed to delivering on our promises to provide clean, reliable, and affordable energy.
Pathfinding: We chart new ground where no path exists by approaching challenges with curiosity, courage, and creativity while navigating ambiguity.

Candidates should be aware that employment may be contingent upon successful completion of a drug screening, and employees may be subject to drug testing at any time in accordance with company policy and applicable laws.

Recruitment Fraud Disclaimer

Oklo is aware of recent recruitment fraud attempts targeting job seekers. Please be cautious of anyone claiming to represent Oklo who does not contact you from an official Oklo email address.

All legitimate communications from our recruiting team— including application updates, interview requests, and job offers — will come exclusively from an If you receive suspicious outreach or have concerns about the authenticity of any communication claiming to be from Oklo, please contact us through the official channels listed on our website.

raw.jobDescription:
Staff Backend Engineer – Platform

Join Apaleo and shape the future of hospitality tech

Apaleo is the world’s most open, API-first property management platform powering the next generation of hospitality operations. Its modular, AI-powered infrastructure lets hoteliers customise their tech stack, automate routine work and deliver seamless, personalised guest experiences, powered by best-in-class apps and autonomous AI agents that adapt to every stay.

If you’re driven by the idea of making hospitality smarter, more human and powered by cutting-edge technology, we’d love to hear from you.

About the role

You’ll join our Platform team as an individual contributor working closely with our Principal Engineer, who leads Platform’s technical direction. Platform owns infrastructure, developer experience and security foundations for the whole engineering org, so this is a high-ownership seat: you’ll take on large, ambiguous, cross-cutting initiatives and drive them from first analysis through to completion, with real autonomy over how you get there.

We don’t run a groomed backlog or sprint planning. We assign a big topic to someone who owns it end to end. If you thrive with structure handed to you, this isn’t the role; if you love spotting the problem worth solving and driving it yourself, you’ll fit right in.

What you’ll be up to

  • Architecting and developing scalable, reliable and maintainable backend systems.
  • Self-identifying and scoping problems and initiatives, not just executing assigned tickets: assessing impact, prioritisation and timing independently.
  • Leading architectural decisions and design discussions with cross-team alignment.
  • Driving large, ambiguous, cross-cutting initiatives end to end, including coordination with multiple stakeholders.
  • Mentoring engineers and driving technical excellence.
  • Building and maintaining internal tools and infrastructure (AWS, Terraform) that empower teams to deliver faster and more reliably.
  • Owning observability, logging and operational excellence to keep the platform highly available.
  • Participating in on-call rotations and stepping in as a reliable problem solver during incidents.
  • Proactively spotting where AI and automation can drive technical improvement.

Some of the challenges waiting for you

  • Solving horizontal write-scaling for our database (we already scale reads horizontally).
  • Modernising our CI/CD pipeline for faster, more reliable delivery.
  • Migrating our infrastructure-as-code fully from CloudFormation to Terraform, including the ability to recreate an Apaleo environment from scratch.
  • Extracting and reworking common services (like shared schedulers) to get us ready for our next scale level.

What you’ll bring to the team

  • 8+ years of backend development experience, including several years in a staff-level or technical leadership role.
  • Strong engineering fundamentals that transfer across languages and cloud platforms: we care more about how you think than which stack you’ve used.
  • A track record of owning large technical initiatives from ambiguity through to completion, ideally on a platform or infrastructure team rather than a pure product team.
  • Experience designing and scaling distributed systems in cloud-native environments (AWS preferred; strong Azure fundamentals with genuine enthusiasm for the switch work just as well).
  • Comfortable working with containerised services and infrastructure-as-code (Docker, Terraform; CloudFormation exposure is relevant given our current stack).
  • Confidence writing your own unit and integration tests: we don’t have a dedicated QA function.
  • Fluent English.

Nice to have

  • Direct experience with C# (.NET), PostgreSQL, AWS and ECS/Kubernetes: a great fit, though not a hard requirement if your fundamentals are strong.
  • Experience setting up infrastructure-as-code from scratch and working with it day to day, ideally with Terraform, including migrating or consolidating from other IaC approaches (like CloudFormation).
  • Experience with Kafka or other event-driven and streaming systems (Azure Service Bus experience is a good transferable equivalent).
  • Hands-on use of AI-assisted development tools (GitHub Copilot, Cursor AI, ChatGPT, Amazon CodeWhisperer) and a genuine interest in AI-driven engineering improvement.
  • Excellent collaboration and communication skills, particularly for introducing new technology, like AI tooling, to other teams.

What we offer

Culture and growth

  • A diverse and international team: work alongside passionate professionals from over 20 nationalities.
  • Growth and development: 360° feedback reviews, a dedicated learning budget and an evolving career framework.
  • Autonomy and ownership: we empower you to take responsibility, make decisions and contribute directly in an environment built on trust and transparency.
  • Shape the future of hospitality tech: your work drives real impact from day one, at a fast-growing scale-up.
  • Competitive and fair compensation, guided by benchmarking data to ensure fairness across all roles and teams.

Perks and lifestyle

  • Flexible and remote work options: office, home or hybrid, based on what works for your role and team.
  • A fully covered Deutschland Ticket for free public transport across Germany.
  • Regular team dinners, company meetups, Oktoberfest celebrations, Christmas parties and other offsite events.
  • 30 days of paid holiday to fully disconnect, recharge and return inspired.
  • An EGYM Wellpass membership giving access to hundreds of gyms, fitness studios and wellness options.

Where you’ll work from

This role is based in Munich, with hybrid working from our office there. We’re also open to remote within Germany, or remote via an Employer of Record for candidates based outside in the EU/ Europe.

We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity and Affirmative Action Employer, committed to fostering a diverse, inclusive and welcoming workplace. We encourage applications from people of all backgrounds, regardless of race, colour, religion, gender identity or expression, sex, national origin, age, marital status, disability or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. Your personal data will be handled with the utmost care and in compliance with GDPR and relevant data protection regulations. We celebrate differences and believe that diversity enriches our team and drives innovation.

title: Projectleider Gebiedsontwikkeling
description: Als projectleider gebiedsontwikkeling bij Waalpartners speel je een cruciale rol in het realiseren van de nieuwbouwopgaven van onze opdrachtgevers. Jij bewaart het overzicht, staat naast de opdrachtgever en draagt bij aan oplossingen voor de uitdagingen die woningbouw met zich meebrengt. Zo hebben we recentelijk meegedacht voor de nieuwe woonomgeving ‘Vlijweide’ in Dordrecht. Bij deze locatie ontwikkeling komt nogal wat bij elkaar. Water, bodem, ecologie, een primaire waterkering én verschillende partijen met ieder hun eigen verantwoordelijkheid en expertise. En dat alles om een toekomstbestendig nieuw woongebied te ontwikkelen. Dit ga je doen Met je brede kennis en jarenlange ervaring sta je stevig in een dynamische projectomgeving. Zowel in de voorbereidende als de uitvoerende fase zorg je ervoor dat het proces vloeiend blijft verlopen, ook bij langdurige integrale projecten. Je eigen netwerk zet je in om de dienstverlening van Waalpartners verder te profileren. Als projectleider ben je bovendien de spil in de ontwikkeling van zowel medewerkers als de organisatie. Dat doe je niet alleen: samen schop je ‘t verder. Je werkt nauw samen met het management en de overige projectleiders over offertes, de bureauplanning en kansen in de markt. Dit ben jij Je bent open, nieuwsgierig en staat als leidinggevende stevig in je schoenen. Je omgeving ziet je als collegiaal en je neemt verantwoordelijkheid over je project en de ontwikkeling van de projectteamleden. Dit bieden wij jou Een salaris tussen €4.500 – €6.900 bruto o.b.v. fulltime dienstverband, afhankelijk van je kennis en ervaring. Groeipad. Met onze Waalacademy bouw je stevig aan je eigen ontwikkeling. Flexibele werktijden. Kom je liever om half 8 binnen, in plaats van half 9? Geen probleem. Hybride werken. We zien je graag op kantoor, omdat we veel met elkaar en onze opdrachtgevers overleggen en samenwerken. Natuurlijk is er ook ruimte om thuis te werken, daarom mag je 2 dagen per week vanuit huis werken (o.b.v. fulltime dienstverband). 27 vakantiedagen Resultaatafhankelijke winstdeling. Draaien we samen een goed jaar? Dan profiteer jij daar ook van! Een goede pensioenregeling onder het oude pensioenstelsel. Een elektrische auto van de zaak, die je ook privé mag gebruiken Plezier. We werken niet alleen aan de ontwikkeling van onze omgeving en onszelf, maar hebben ‘t ook leuk met elkaar. Onze personeelsvereniging organiseert regelmatig activiteiten, we gaan samen op citytrip of een paar kilometer hardlopen. Dit breng jij mee Je hebt de drive om een project voor alle belanghebbenden tot een goed einde te brengen. Jij vindt het belangrijk om jezelf, samen met je collega’s, te blijven ontwikkelen. Je hebt een civieltechnische opleiding (hbo werk- en denkniveau). Je spreekt vloeiend Nederlands en kunt jezelf goed verwoorden: In gesprek en op papier. Je hebt de ervaring om complexe projecten te doorzien en te begeleiden. Je hebt gevoel voor thema’s als binnenstedelijke herinrichting, klimaatadaptatie of geotechniek. raw.jobDescription:
About Us:

Nivoda: Where Innovation and Gemstones Meet 💎

At Nivoda, we’re reimagining how the world buys and sells jewellery. Our global marketplace connects retailers and suppliers across diamonds, gemstones, and finished jewellery - already powering over $300M in annual transactions and scaling fast toward our billion-dollar vision.

We’re bringing tech, data, and automation to a $350B industry that’s barely scratched the surface of digital transformation. The result? Explosive growth and massive opportunity powered by a team that makes it happen.

Our Mission

The idea of Nivoda was inspired by the ongoing inefficiency of diamond trading. We set out to develop the solution to help businesses, regardless of their size or location, increase their sales and margins, whilst removing the operational burden of sourcing diamonds.

The Engineering & RevOps Team

Our Engineering and RevOps teams sit at the heart of everything Nivoda builds. We move fast, take ownership, and obsess over scalable systems that let our commercial teams fly. We’re a remote-first, globally distributed team that values directness, low ego, and big impact. If you want to build meaningful things without layers of bureaucracy, you’re in the right place.

About the Role

We’re looking for a Salesforce Developer to join our growing Salesforce team, working alongside our existing developer and RevOps. We’ve completed our migration from HubSpot to Salesforce, and the focus now is on making our new instance the single home for our commercial processes and tooling. You’ll consolidate and harden what we’ve built, retire legacy tools into Salesforce, and help shape what comes next: deeper Sales Cloud capability, exploring Service Cloud and Marketing Cloud, and putting Salesforce’s newer AI features, including Agentforce, to real use.

What would YOU be doing?

  • Consolidate processes and tooling into Salesforce, replacing point solutions and manual workarounds with flows, Apex and native features

  • Build and maintain Sales Cloud improvements: lead and opportunity automation, routing and round-robin, stage gates, Lightning pages and LWCs

  • Prototype and deliver Agentforce and AI use cases with RevOps, such as rep assistants, next-best-action and record summaries

  • Support the exploration and rollout of Service Cloud (e.g. Cases for onboarding and support processes) and Marketing Cloud

  • Build back-end Salesforce solutions — writing Apex code, managing workflows, process automation, and API integrations

  • Maintain integrations with our GTM stack (Snowflake, Gong, Customer.io, Shopify), working with our data engineering team to keep data clean after the migration

  • Work closely with Sales, Marketing, Revenue Operations, Customer and Supplier-facing teams to understand business requirements and translate them into scalable Salesforce solutions

  • Take part in sprint planning, effort estimation and prioritisation, and deliver on sprint commitments

  • Work a shared sprint backlog with our other Salesforce developer: peer-review code, share on-call bug fixing, and keep documentation current

  • Document everything you build — create and maintain comprehensive technical documentation to ensure smooth handovers and maintainability

What do we need from YOU?

  • Salesforce Platform Developer I certification (essential)

  • Strong Apex coding skills — you write clean, efficient, well-documented code

  • Solid SQL skills and ability to build and map APIs and integrations

  • 2–5 years of Salesforce development experience, ideally in a scaling company

  • Confident with Flow, LWC, SOQL and the Salesforce deployment lifecycle (sandboxes, change sets or SFDX, version control)

  • Strong Sales Cloud experience; exposure to Service Cloud or Marketing Cloud a plus

  • Self-motivated with a strategic mindset — you identify problems before they become fires

  • Collaborative: comfortable sharing a codebase, reviewing others’ work and taking feedback

  • Strong documentation habits — you leave things better than you found them

Nice to have

  • Salesforce Platform Developer II, Service Cloud or Marketing Cloud certifications

  • Experience in marketplace, e-commerce, or SaaS businesses

  • Background in companies at Series A–D stage where you’ve built things from scratch

  • Experience with Snowflake or similar data warehousing tools

  • Experience stabilising or consolidating an org after a CRM migration

  • Hands-on experience with Agentforce, Einstein or Prompt Builder

Our culture and what we offer

At Nivoda, we believe that employees today want to evolve in a collaborative, high-growth environment where they can demonstrate their abilities and thrive both professionally and personally. We are convinced that employees need to find alignment between their inner values and their company’s culture and mission to unlock their full potential. We work to create a culture of empowerment, continuous learning and growth where everyone can bring expertise, own projects and easily measure their impact.

Dynamic working environment in a rapidly growing company.
Enjoy a pleasant, low-hierarchy work environment.
Engage in intellectually challenging work that contributes significantly to Nivoda’s success and scalability.

Our benefits

🕰️ Flexible working hours and a vibrant company culture
💻 Remote work
🧠 Plenty of opportunities for growth and learning
🏖️ Unlimited holiday allowance
🚀 Chance to join and contribute to a company during its exponential expansion phase

Nivoda is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace dedicated to promoting diversity. We don’t discriminate on the basis of race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status or disability status.
Even if it seems you don’t meet 100% of our musts don’t let it stop you, we are all about finding the best talent out there! Skills can be learned, and embracing diversity is invaluable.

Please note: Our Talent Acquisition Team is international coming from across the world. We kindly ask you to please submit your CV and application in English so that it can be reviewed correctly.

*If after reading this job description you believe this is not the best fit for you, we’d encourage you to join our Talent Pool so we can keep you in mind as new roles open up.
You can sign up here: Nivoda Talent Pool

title: Senior Developer Advocate - Modern App Development
description: We are a team of engineers that translate our real-world experience to help our user communities solve problems. With a focus on AI-accelerated workflows and next-generation developer ecosystems, you will have the opportunity to meet fast-moving teams where they are, helping them lay strong engineering foundations and broadening your impact to the developer community at large. This is a unique opportunity to use both your engineering depth and authentic storytelling skills to shape how the next wave of builders approach software health, scalability, and observability. What You’ll Do: Help developers hone their craft in an AI-accelerated world by exploring how AI coding assistants and rapid-prototyping tools change software workflows, and guiding teams on how to balance rapid prototyping with established engineering practices around performance, code health, and system reliability. Build in public by creating authentic, peer-to-peer technical content, sharing your engineering insights directly where modern developers collaborate in person and online. Drive a constructive, bidirectional feedback loop between fast-moving developer communities and our internal teams, translating real-world developer experiences into actionable product insights to shape our roadmap while advocating for user needs from the inside. Design and ship high-quality open-source boilerplate templates, quickstarts, and tools that make integrating observability seamless across AI native workflows, next-gen platforms (Vercel, Supabase, etc.), and cloud providers (AWS, GCP, Azure). Who You Are: A builder with approximately 10+ years of software engineering experience, ideally having shipped applications from scratch or worked within an early-stage startup environment where you've worn multiple hats. An AI-fluent developer who natively leverages AI coding assistants and rapid-prototyping tools as a core part of your regular, day-to-day development workflow. Multi-stack familiar, comfortable writing and debugging code across multiple programming languages (such as JavaScript/TypeScript or Python) and experienced with deployment paradigms spanning next-gen platforms and traditional cloud ecosystems. An authentic communicator with approximately 3+ years of experience in technical storytelling and community engagement, backed by a publicly available portfolio of peer-to-peer artifacts like GitHub repositories, technical blogs, video walkthroughs, or public speaking presentations. A forward thinker who loves self-driven exploration of emerging technologies, and is deeply passionate about developer education, mentorship, and helping other engineers hone their craft. Bonus points: Active community presence or leadership: You are an active participant, contributor, or moderator in developer spaces (such as meetups, Discord, Reddit, or open-source ecosystems focused on next-gen tech). Datadog values people from all walks of life. We understand not everyone will meet all the above qualifications on day one. That's okay. If you’re passionate about technology and want to grow your skills, we encourage you to apply. Benefits and Growth: New hire stock equity (RSUs) and employee stock purchase plan (ESPP) Continuous professional development, product training, and career pathing Intradepartmental mentor and buddy program for in-house networking An inclusive company culture, ability to join our Community Guilds (Datadog employee resource groups) Access to Inclusion Talks, our Internal panel discussions Free, global mental health benefits for employees and dependents age 6+ Competitive global benefits Benefits and Growth listed above may vary based on the country of your employment and the nature of your employment with Datadog. #LI-Remote Datadog offers a competitive salary and equity package, and may include variable compensation. Actual compensation is based on factors such as the candidate's skills, qualifications, and experience. In addition, Datadog offers a wide range of best in class, comprehensive and inclusive employee benefits for this role including healthcare, dental, parental planning, and mental health benefits, a 401(k) plan and match, paid time off, fitness reimbursements, and a discounted employee stock purchase plan. The reasonably estimated yearly salary for this role at Datadog is: $172,000—$215,000 USD About Datadog: Datadog is the leading observability and security platform for the AI era, providing businesses with unified visibility across the technology stack to manage complexity at scale. It brings applications, infrastructure, data, models, and security into one place, using AI to detect and resolve issues before they impact customers. Trusted globally by Fortune 500 companies and high-growth AI leaders, Datadog enables businesses to move faster with clarity and confidence. Learn more about #DatadogLife on Instagram , LinkedIn, and Datadog Learning Center. Equal Opportunity at Datadog: Datadog is proud to offer equal employment opportunity to everyone regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, veteran status, and other characteristics protected by law. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. Here are our Candidate Legal Notices for your reference. With a focus on AI-accelerated workflows and next-generation developer ecosystems, you will have the opportunity to meet fast-moving teams where they are, helping them lay strong engineering foundations and broadening your impact to the developer community at large. This is a unique opportunity to use both your engineering depth and authentic storytelling skills to shape how the next wave of builders approach software health, scalability, and observability.


What You’ll Do:

  • Help developers hone their craft in an AI-accelerated world by exploring how AI coding assistants and rapid-prototyping tools change software workflows, and guiding teams on how to balance rapid prototyping with established engineering practices around performance, code health, and system reliability.
  • Build in public by creating authentic, peer-to-peer technical content, sharing your engineering insights directly where modern developers collaborate in person and online.
  • Drive a constructive, bidirectional feedback loop between fast-moving developer communities and our internal teams, translating real-world developer experiences into actionable product insights to shape our roadmap while advocating for user needs from the inside.
  • Design and ship high-quality open-source boilerplate templates, quickstarts, and tools that make integrating observability seamless across AI native workflows, next-gen platforms (Vercel, Supabase, etc.), and cloud providers (AWS, GCP, Azure).


Who You Are:

  • A builder with approximately 10+ years of software engineering experience, ideally having shipped applications from scratch or worked within an early-stage startup environment where you've worn multiple hats.
  • An AI-fluent developer who natively leverages AI coding assistants and rapid-prototyping tools as a core part of your regular, day-to-day development workflow.
  • Multi-stack familiar, comfortable writing and debugging code across multiple programming languages (such as JavaScript/TypeScript or Python) and experienced with deployment paradigms spanning next-gen platforms and traditional cloud ecosystems.
  • An authentic communicator with approximately 3+ years of experience in technical storytelling and community engagement, backed by a publicly available portfolio of peer-to-peer artifacts like GitHub repositories, technical blogs, video walkthroughs, or public speaking presentations.
  • A forward thinker who loves self-driven exploration of emerging technologies, and is deeply passionate about developer education, mentorship, and helping other engineers hone their craft.

Bonus points:

  • Active community presence or leadership: You are an active participant, contributor, or moderator in developer spaces (such as meetups, Discord, Reddit, or open-source ecosystems focused on next-gen tech).

Datadog values people from all walks of life. We understand not everyone will meet all the above qualifications on day one. That's okay. If you’re passionate about technology and want to grow your skills, we encourage you to apply.

Benefits and Growth:

  • New hire stock equity (RSUs) and employee stock purchase plan (ESPP)
  • Continuous professional development, product training, and career pathing
  • Intradepartmental mentor and buddy program for in-house networking
  • An inclusive company culture, ability to join our Community Guilds (Datadog employee resource groups)
  • Access to Inclusion Talks, our Internal panel discussions
  • Free, global mental health benefits for employees and dependents age 6+
  • Competitive global benefits

Benefits and Growth listed above may vary based on the country of your employment and the nature of your employment with Datadog.

#LI-Remote

Datadog offers a competitive salary and equity package, and may include variable compensation. Actual compensation is based on factors such as the candidate's skills, qualifications, and experience. In addition, Datadog offers a wide range of best in class, comprehensive and inclusive employee benefits for this role including healthcare, dental, parental planning, and mental health benefits, a 401(k) plan and match, paid time off, fitness reimbursements, and a discounted employee stock purchase plan.

The reasonably estimated yearly salary for this role at Datadog is:

$172,000—$215,000 USD

About Datadog:

Datadog is the leading observability and security platform for the AI era, providing businesses with unified visibility across the technology stack to manage complexity at scale. It brings applications, infrastructure, data, models, and security into one place, using AI to detect and resolve issues before they impact customers. Trusted globally by Fortune 500 companies and high-growth AI leaders, Datadog enables businesses to move faster with clarity and confidence. Learn more about #DatadogLife on Instagram, LinkedIn, and Datadog Learning Center.

Equal Opportunity at Datadog:

Datadog is proud to offer equal employment opportunity to everyone regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, veteran status, and other characteristics protected by law. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. Here are our Candidate Legal Notices for your reference.

This form is for accommodation requests only and cannot be used to inquire about the status of applications.

About Us:

Nivoda: where innovation and gemstones meet

At Nivoda, we help jewellery retailers and gemstone suppliers trade more easily. Our B2B marketplace connects jewellery businesses of all sizes with global diamond and gemstone supply.

Nivoda has more than 400 employees across the world. Our platform helps buyers and sellers trade diamonds and gemstones securely, efficiently and at competitive prices.

The Data & Financial Platform team

The Data & Financial Platform team owns Nivoda's data platform plus the shared financial capabilities of the marketplace. Its job is to make core data and financial systems reliable, useful and scalable.

This role sits in the team but works day to day with GTM. You will work with the Head of Data, engineers, analysts, Sales and Marketing as we rebuild Nivoda's GTM infrastructure.

About the role

Nivoda is rebuilding its GTM infrastructure. Too much of the funnel still relies on manual steps, disconnected tools and fragile hand-offs. This role exists to replace them with reliable systems and automation.

You will work across our platform, GTM Engine, Salesforce, Customer.io, enrichment services, Snowflake and other tools. Salesforce is an important integration point, but you will not own it. Start with the problem, choose the simplest sensible approach, then build or configure what is needed.

This is a hands-on engineering role working closely with the Head of Data and experienced engineers. You will have context and clear priorities, with room to work through the detail, propose an approach and ship it safely.

What would you be doing?

  • Work with GTM stakeholders to turn unclear process requests into clear technical requirements and a sensible implementation approach.

  • Build integrations, customer or prospect event flows, automations and changes to our GTM Engine. Use APIs, webhooks, queues, scheduled workflows or small services where they fit.

  • Choose build, buy or configure based on the problem. Prefer native platform capability first, tooling or middleware second, custom code where it creates real value.

  • Build for production from the start. Test common failure paths, handle duplicates and retries, then add the monitoring needed to spot problems quickly.

  • Ship and support what you build using version control, code review and safe deployment. Help troubleshoot or recover failures after launch.

  • Work with Salesforce, other platform owners and our Commercial Data Analyst to integrate cleanly while making sure systems emit the data needed to measure performance.

  • Document important flows, decisions and recovery steps so the stack does not depend on one person.

What do we need from you?

  • 2+ years in software, systems or integration engineering. You have shipped real integrations or services using APIs, webhooks or event-driven systems.

  • Solid programming ability in Python, JavaScript or TypeScript. Working SQL plus confidence using Git and code review.

  • Experience integrating with business systems such as CRM, payments, finance, marketing or operations platforms. Salesforce experience is useful but not required.

  • You can work directly with non-technical stakeholders. You can challenge an unclear request and turn the underlying need into something buildable.

  • You can learn unfamiliar systems quickly, then choose the simplest solution that will hold up in production.

  • You think about failure cases such as unavailable APIs, duplicate records or conflicting updates before they become production problems.

Nice to have

  • Experience at a marketplace or a company selling to small businesses at volume.

  • Hands-on time with an iPaaS or workflow tool such as n8n, Zapier or Workato.

  • Familiarity with tools in our stack such as Snowflake, Customer.io, Gong, Clay or similar systems.

  • Experience with cloud runtimes, CI/CD, observability or production support.

Our culture and what we offer

  • Flexible working hours and a vibrant company culture

  • Private health insurance

  • Opportunities for growth and learning

  • Flexible compensation card (meals, transport, childcare)

  • Unlimited holiday allowance

  • The chance to join during an exponential expansion phase

Equal opportunity

Nivoda is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. Even if it seems you don't meet 100% of our musts, don't let that stop you: we would still love to hear from you.

Please submit your CV in English.

Not the right role for you right now? Join the Nivoda Talent Pool and we will keep you in mind for future opportunities.

Legion is an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, religion, color, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, national origin, veteran, disability status, or any other basis covered by appropriate law.

How We Determine What We Pay

As a global employer, Legion determines pay for positions using local, national, and industry-specific survey data. We evaluate external equity and the cost of labor/prevailing wage index in the relative marketplace for jobs directly comparable to jobs within our company. Our posted salary range is based on national data and may be refined for a candidate's region/town/cost of living. For new hires, we strive to make competitive offers allowing the new employee room for future growth. Salaries will be based on the applicant’s location, level of experience, education, and specialized knowledge and skills. Additionally, we consider the external market rate, the amount we have budgeted internally, and internal equity within the company for the same position. An employee/candidate with a stronger skill set will receive higher pay.

Job Applicant Privacy Policy

This Job Applicant Privacy Policy (“Policy”) describes how Legion Technologies, Inc. (“Legion”, “we”, “us” and “our”) collects, uses, and discloses “personal information” as defined under California law from and about job applicants who are residents of California.

This Policy does not apply to our handling of data gathered about you in your role as a user of our consumer-facing services. When you interact with us as in that role, the Legion Privacy Policy applies.

  1. Types of Personal Information We Handle

    We collect, store, and use various types of personal information through the application and recruitment process. We collect such information either directly from you or (where applicable) from another person or entity, such as an employment agency or consultancy, background check provider, or other referral sources. This information includes:

    • Identification and contact information, and related identifiers such as full name, date and place of birth, citizenship and permanent residence, home and business addresses, telephone numbers, email addresses, and such information about your beneficiaries or emergency contacts.
    • Professional or employment-related information, including:
      • Recruitment, employment, or engagement information such as application forms and information included in a resume, cover letter, or otherwise provided through any application or engagement process; and copies of identification documents, such as driver’s licenses, passports, and visas; and background screening results and references.
      • Career information such as job titles; work history; work dates and work locations; information about skills, qualifications, experience, publications, speaking engagements, and preferences; and professional memberships
    • Education Information such as institutions attended, degrees, certifications, training courses, publications, and transcript information.
    • Legally protected classification information such as race, sex/gender, religious/ philosophical beliefs, gender identity/expression, sexual orientation, marital status, military service, nationality, ethnicity, request for family care leave, political opinions, and criminal history.
    • Other information such as any information you voluntarily choose to provide in connection with your job application.

  2. How We Use Personal Information

    We collect, use, share, and store personal information from job applicants for our and our service providers’ business and operational purposes in the recruitment process such as: processing your application, tracking your application through the recruitment process, contacting references with your authorization, conducting background checks you authorize, and making hiring decisions. We will also use job applicant information for internal analysis purposes to understand the applicants who apply and to improve our recruitment process. We may sometimes need to use applicant information for legal purposes, such as in connection with any challenges made to our hiring decisions.

  3. With Whom We Share Personal Information

    We will disclose job applicant personal information to the following types of entities or in the following circumstances (where applicable):

    • Internally: to other Legion personnel involved in the recruiting and hiring process.
    • Vendors: such as technology service providers, travel management providers, human resources suppliers, background check companies, and employment agencies or recruiters, where applicable.
    • Legal Compliance: when required to do so by law, regulation, or court order or in response to a request for assistance by the police or other law enforcement agency.
    • Litigation Purposes: to seek legal advice from our external lawyers or in connection with litigation with a third party.
    • Business Transaction Purposes: in connection with the sale, purchase, or merger.
  4. How to Contact Us About this Policy – If you have any questions about this Policy, please contact privacy@legion.co.

Chainguard is the trusted source for open source. By delivering hardened, secure, and production-ready builds of all the open source software engineers and AI agents rely on, Chainguard helps organizations build faster, stay compliant, and eliminate risk.

Our customers include Fortune 500 enterprises and global industry leaders, including Anduril, Canva, Fortinet, Hewlett Packard Enterprise, OpenAI, Snap Inc., and Snowflake.

Chainguard is venture-backed by leading investors, including Amplify, IVP, Kleiner Perkins, Lightspeed Venture Partners, Mantis VC, Redpoint Ventures, Sequoia Capital, and Spark Capital.

The role, in a nutshell:

At Chainguard we're focused on securing the software supply chain, and we're building the next generation of products at the intersection of security and AI. We're looking for an engineering manager to lead a fast-moving team shipping tools that developers will actually use — the Guardener, hardened GitHub Actions, Chainguard Agent Skills, and new products built on our microVM sandbox platform.

You'll own these products end-to-end: hire and grow the team, set the roadmap with Product, and stay hands-on enough to dig into the code. This is a high-ownership role for someone who moves fast, takes initiative, and measures success by what ships and who uses it.

What you'll do:

  • Own a portfolio of products end-to-end — the Guardener, hardened GitHub Actions, Chainguard Agent Skills, and emerging microVM-based products — from roadmap through implementation, rollout, and iteration.
  • Hire, lead, and grow a small team of strong engineers. Remove blockers and create the conditions for them to do their best work.
  • Stay technically hands-on: review designs and PRs, prototype when it unblocks the team, and unblock the team
  • Partner closely with Product on a roadmap with real deadlines — help the team prioritize tradeoffs and ship iteratively rather than waiting for perfect.
  • Navigate ambiguous problems and find a clear path forward. You take initiative rather than waiting for complete specs.
  • Own the quality and reliability of what you ship, and stay close to customers to turn their feedback directly into the roadmap.

What we're looking for:

  • 2+ years experience managing engineers with a genuine, sustained passion for leading and growing a team.
